properties.title: Pacific Point 903 – Oceanfront 2-Bedroom Condo with Lock-Off
properties.author: Shawnfletcher

content.body:
Welcome to Pacific Point 903, a beautifully positioned 9th-floor oceanfront condominium located directly on the beach in the heart of Jacó, Costa Rica. From this elevated residence, enjoy sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean to the north, stunning sunsets, and impressive mountain views from multiple vantage points throughout the condo.

What truly sets this property apart is its versatile lock-off configuration. The condo features two separate entrances, allowing each side to be used or rented independently. Both sides also enjoy their own private ocean-view balcony, creating excellent flexibility for owners who want to maximize rental income, use one side personally while renting the other, or simply enjoy added privacy for guests.

The condo offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,044 square feet of living space and is being sold fully furnished, making it ready for immediate personal use or vacation rental operation.

Pacific Point Building Amenities

Direct beachfront location in the heart of Jacó

Oceanfront semi-Olympic lap pool

Kids pool and BBQ area

Rooftop terrace with panoramic ocean and mountain views

Fitness center

Co-working and conference space

24-hour security

Covered parking

Laundry center

One of the biggest advantages of Pacific Point is its unbeatable location. Step outside and you are within walking distance of dozens of restaurants, shops, nightlife, supermarkets, and everything Jacó Beach has to offer.

Whether you are looking for a full-time residence, vacation home, or income-producing investment property, Pacific Point 903 combines oceanfront living with one of the most flexible rental layouts in the building.

Contact us today for more information or to schedule a private showing of Pacific Point 903.

properties.title: Suenos Del Mar Luxury Villas | Homes
properties.author: Dominique Brousseau

content.body:
Introducing the Sueños Del Mar Villas, an exclusive collection of just 32 luxury private homes within the highly anticipated Sueños Del Mar community in Jacó Beach. Designed for those seeking elevated tropical living, these villas combine architectural elegance, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, and resort-style privacy just a short walk from the beach.

The villa collection features two distinct home designs: the expansive Oasis Villas, offering two-level residences, and the serene Villas El Bosque, designed as single-level retreats immersed in nature. Each home is thoughtfully positioned within lush tropical surroundings, creating a sense of privacy, tranquility, and connection to the natural environment.

All villas are designed with 3 or 4 bedrooms, generous open-concept living areas, and a strong emphasis on indoor-outdoor integration. Every residence includes a private swimming pool, elegant entertaining spaces, and expansive terraces, making each home a true personal sanctuary ideal for both relaxation and hosting.

The price includes appliances and closing costs.

Oasis Villas — 2 Levels | 3–4 Bedrooms | 310 m² / 3,337 sq. ft.

The Oasis Villas are sophisticated two-level residences offering approximately 310 m² (3,337 sq. ft.) of interior living space on generous lots of approximately 400 m² (4,306 sq. ft.). These homes are designed to maximize space, light, and flow, with open living areas that extend effortlessly to outdoor terraces and a private pool.

Villas El Bosque — 1 Level | 3–4 Bedrooms | 258–310 m² / 2,777–3,337 sq. ft.

The Villas El Bosque offer a refined single-level living experience, designed for comfort, accessibility, and harmony with nature. Ranging from approximately 258 m² to 310 m² (2,777 to 3,337 sq. ft.), these residences feature 3 or 4 bedrooms and open-concept layouts that flow seamlessly into outdoor living spaces.

Each villa includes a private pool, shaded terraces, and beautifully integrated indoor-outdoor entertaining areas, creating a peaceful retreat surrounded by tropical greenery. The single-level design enhances ease of living while maintaining a strong connection to the surrounding landscape.

Across both villa styles, residents will enjoy the same commitment to quality, design, and lifestyle that defines Sueños Del Mar. Every home is crafted to deliver a sense of privacy, comfort, and effortless luxury within a vibrant resort-style community.

As part of the broader Sueños Del Mar development, villa owners also benefit from access to an exceptional collection of amenities, including a clubhouse with social and wellness spaces, a 48-meter “Oasis” pool, fitness and yoga facilities, spa services, coworking areas, forest trails, botanical gardens, sports courts, and more.

With only 32 villas available, this is a rare opportunity to own a private luxury residence in one of Jacó Beach’s most exclusive new communities—where modern design, nature, and resort living come together in perfect balance.

properties.title: Sueños Del Mar — Luxury Condos
properties.author: Dominique Brousseau

content.body:
Introducing Sueños Del Mar, an exclusive new residential community in Jacó Beach offering just 16 luxury condominiums in a private, thoughtfully designed tropical setting. Located only a short walk from the beach, this boutique development combines generous living spaces, resort-style amenities, and the natural beauty of Costa Rica’s Central Pacific.

The condos at Sueños Del Mar will consist of four intimate two-story buildings, each with only four residences, creating a sense of privacy and exclusivity rarely found in larger condominium developments. The project is being developed by the same team behind the highly successful Ciudad Del Mar, located just steps away.

Two distinct residence styles are available.

Ground-Level Residences — 3 Bedrooms | 2.5 Bathrooms | 305 m² / 3,281 sq. ft.

The spacious ground-floor residences are designed around seamless indoor-outdoor living. Each home features approximately 305 m² (3,281 sq. ft.) of living space with three bedrooms and two-and-a-half bathrooms, along with a private garden and exclusive swimming pool. Generous social areas flow naturally toward the outdoors, creating an ideal setting for entertaining, relaxing, and enjoying Jacó’s tropical climate.

Upper-Level Residences — 4 Bedrooms | 3 Bathrooms | 271 m² / 2,920 sq. ft.

The upper residences offer approximately 271 m² (2,920 sq. ft.) with four bedrooms and three bathrooms. Open-concept interiors extend onto expansive private terraces, where residents can enjoy peaceful views toward the surrounding rainforest and a greater sense of connection with the natural landscape.

Both residence types include covered parking and are designed with spacious layouts, contemporary tropical living, and everyday comfort in mind.

What truly distinguishes Sueños Del Mar is its exceptional collection of private community amenities. At the heart of the development will be an elegant clubhouse featuring a grand living room, game area with billiards and table games, and a dedicated wine and spirits bar. Residents will also enjoy a fitness studio, yoga deck, spa, coworking space, and firepit terrace.

The centerpiece of the outdoor experience will be an impressive 48-meter “Oasis” swimming pool, complemented by a sundeck, daybeds, wellness kiosk, and private poolside cabanas. Lush tropical gardens and thoughtfully landscaped grounds will extend throughout the community, including forest trails with elevated walkways, butterfly and botanical gardens, and inviting spaces to reconnect with nature.

Recreational amenities include a pickleball court, putting and chipping green, children’s park, and dedicated dog park, offering something for residents of every age and lifestyle.

With only 16 condominiums, an extraordinary amenity package, proximity to the beach, and a proven development team, Sueños Del Mar presents a rare opportunity to own a spacious luxury residence in one of Jacó’s most desirable new communities.

The price includes appliances and closing costs.

Whether envisioned as a full-time residence, tropical retreat, or investment property, Sueños Del Mar brings together privacy, recreation, wellness, and sophisticated coastal living just minutes from everything Jacó has to offer.

Kids and adults alike will love the luxury Crate & Barrel queen bunk bed set, complete with built-in cabinets, electric, and storage. The living room features a modern sofa with chaise lounge and an oversized chair, anchored by a custom dining table handcrafted locally in Costa Rica.

Las Nubes is a highly desirable, diverse community home to Americans, Costa Ricans, and Europeans alike — and a rare find for families, thanks to the top-rated international private school located right within the gates, serving students from Pre-K through high school.

properties.title: Jungle View Villa | Canada Hill | Esterillos Oeste Beach
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
This jungle view villa is just steps from the “blue flag” Esterillos Oeste Beach!

Discover your private tropical retreat in the charming seaside village of Esterillos Oeste, where lush jungle meets the Pacific Ocean. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac and surrounded by tropical greenery, this beautifully maintained multi-level villa offers exceptional privacy, breathtaking jungle views, and is just a 5 minute walk from one of Costa Rica’s most pristine beaches.

Located only 20 minutes south of Jacó, 45 minutes from Manuel Antonio National Park, and approximately 90 minutes from Juan Santamaría International Airport (SJO), this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience.

Designed to embrace Costa Rica’s indoor-outdoor lifestyle, the villa features spacious living areas spread across three levels with multiple covered terraces overlooking the large private pool, tropical gardens, and surrounding rainforest. Whether you’re enjoying your morning coffee while listening to the sounds of the jungle or relaxing with a sunset cocktail, every terrace provides a peaceful connection to nature.

The home offers three comfortable bedrooms and three full bathrooms, with air conditioning in the bedrooms, ceiling fans throughout, and refreshing ocean breezes that keep the home comfortable year-round. The modern kitchen is fully equipped with quality appliances, including a large refrigerator, five-burner gas stove, microwave, and ample workspace for entertaining family and guests.

Additional features include:

Private lap pool surrounded by lush tropical landscaping

Three expansive terraces with jungle and mountain views

Outdoor kitchen and entertainment area

Outdoor shower

High-speed Wi-Fi and cable television

Air conditioning in bedrooms

Hot water throughout with backup system

Fully equipped laundry and utility room

Abundant storage space

Steel-reinforced concrete construction built to North American standards

Impeccably maintained and move-in ready

Nature lovers will appreciate the incredible biodiversity that surrounds the property. Daily visitors often include white-faced capuchin monkeys, scarlet macaws, toucans, sloths, hummingbirds, parrots, iguanas, and countless other tropical species, creating an unforgettable living experience in one of Costa Rica’s richest ecological regions.

Esterillos Oeste is a welcoming beach community where locals and expatriates enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle. Within walking distance you’ll find grocery stores, cafés, restaurants, and local bars, while miles of uncrowded beach invite you to surf, explore tide pools, horseback ride, fish, beachcomb, or simply unwind by the ocean. Adventure activities including ziplining, ATV tours, and surfing lessons are all nearby, while the vibrant nightlife, shopping, casinos, and entertainment of Jacó are just minutes away.

Beyond its exceptional lifestyle appeal, this villa has also proven to be a highly desirable vacation rental thanks to its outstanding location, privacy, and proximity to the beach and local amenities. Whether you’re searching for a full-time residence, vacation getaway, or income-producing investment property, this home offers an outstanding opportunity to own a piece of paradise on Costa Rica’s Central Pacific Coast.

Experience the best of tropical living—where peaceful jungle surroundings, beautiful beaches, and modern comforts come together in one extraordinary property.

Pacific Point 201 is a beautifully furnished direct oceanfront condo located on the 2nd floor of the Pacific Point building in the heart of Jaco Beach, Costa Rica. Measuring 1,087 square feet, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence is being offered fully furnished and turn-key ready.

The condo features an open-concept kitchen and living area that face directly toward the ocean, creating a bright and inviting space for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen is finished with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and modern cabinetry. Just off the kitchen, there is a laundry room and pantry area that could also serve as convenient owner storage.

One of the standout features of Pacific Point 201 is the oversized oceanfront balcony, accessible from both the living room and the master bedroom. This spacious outdoor area is perfect for enjoying the ocean breeze, watching the waves, and taking in the beachfront setting.

The master bedroom features floor-to-ceiling corner glass, a king-size bed, walk-in closet, and ensuite bathroom with dual vanities. The second bedroom is furnished with a queen-size bed and offers ample closet space, making the condo comfortable for owners, guests, or vacation renters.

Pacific Point is one of Jaco Beach’s premier oceanfront condominium buildings, ideally located within easy walking distance to restaurants, shops, nightlife, and daily conveniences. The building offers an impressive selection of amenities, including a semi-Olympic lap lane length pool directly in front of the ocean, a kids pool above the parking garage, a BBQ area, and poolside bathrooms.

Residents and guests also enjoy access to a gym, coworking space, conference room, and game area with ping pong and foosball. Additional conveniences include covered parking, 24-hour security, and an onsite laundromat, which is especially useful for quick Airbnb changeovers.

Last but most important, Pacific Point features an incredible rooftop terrace on the 13th floor with panoramic sunset views over the ocean and Jaco Beach. With its direct oceanfront location, turn-key furnishings, strong rental appeal, and excellent building amenities, Pacific Point 201 is an outstanding opportunity in one of Costa Rica’s most popular beach towns.

Exceptional opportunity to acquire 26,954 m² (6.67 acres) of lush tropical land with breathtaking panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean, Playa Hermosa, and the surrounding mountains. Located in one of the Central Pacific’s fastest-growing luxury real estate markets, this property offers outstanding potential for investors and developers.

Property Highlights:

* 26,954 m² (6.67 acres) of gently sloping tropical jungle with spectacular ocean and mountain views.

* Panoramic views overlooking Playa Hermosa and the Pacific coastline.

* Located in an area experiencing strong growth with luxury homes, private estates, boutique villas, and highly profitable vacation rental properties.

* Fully paved public road runs along the entire property, providing easy year-round access.

* Electricity can be easily connected from the roadside.

* Water can be sourced by constructing a private well on the property.

Outstanding Value:

* Offered at just $18 per m², making it one of the best-priced ocean-view development parcels in the area.

* Excellent investment opportunity in a market with continued appreciation and increasing demand for luxury real estate.

Prime Location:

* Only 8 minutes from Playa Hermosa, one of Costa Rica’s most famous surf beaches, attracting hundreds of thousands of visitors each year and hosting international surfing competitions.

* Just 15 minutes from Jacó, offering restaurants, shopping, nightlife, medical services, and all modern conveniences.

* Approximately 25 minutes from Esterillos, a peaceful beach town known for its beautiful coastline and excellent surf.

Development Potential:

* Subdivide into approximately five 5,000 m² ocean-view lots for resale or custom home construction.

* Develop a boutique eco-resort or holistic wellness retreat with yoga facilities and eco-cabins.

* Build a collection of luxury ocean-view villas designed for the lucrative vacation rental market.

* Create a private estate or exclusive gated community surrounded by nature and spectacular views.

With its panoramic ocean views, paved road access, readily available utilities, exceptional value, and multiple development possibilities, this property is a rare opportunity to invest in one of Costa Rica’s most desirable and rapidly growing coastal destinations.

TERRENO CON VISTA AL MAR – 26.954 m² (6.67 Acres)

Excelente oportunidad de inversión para adquirir un terreno de 26.954 m² (6.67 acres) rodeado de exuberante selva tropical, con impresionantes vistas panorámicas al Océano Pacífico, Playa Hermosa y las montañas. Ubicado en una de las zonas de mayor crecimiento del Pacífico Central, este terreno ofrece un enorme potencial para desarrollos residenciales, turísticos o comerciales.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PROPIEDAD

• 26.954 m² (6.67 acres) de terreno con topografía ideal para desarrollo.

• Espectaculares vistas panorámicas al mar, Playa Hermosa y las montañas.

• Rodeado de naturaleza, privacidad y abundante vida silvestre.

• Ubicado en una zona con un crecimiento acelerado de residencias de lujo, villas exclusivas y rentables alquileres vacacionales.

• La carretera que bordea toda la propiedad está completamente asfaltada, garantizando un acceso cómodo durante todo el año.

• La electricidad se encuentra disponible al frente de la propiedad y puede conectarse fácilmente.

• El abastecimiento de agua puede realizarse mediante la construcción de un pozo propio.

EXCELENTE RELACIÓN PRECIO-VALOR

• Precio de tan solo **US$18 por m²**, convirtiéndolo en una de las mejores oportunidades de inversión con vista al mar en la zona.

• Gran potencial de plusvalía gracias al constante desarrollo de proyectos de alto nivel en los alrededores.

UBICACIÓN PRIVILEGIADA

• A solo 8 minutos de Playa Hermosa, una de las playas de surf más reconocidas de Costa Rica, sede de competencias internacionales y visitada por cientos de miles de turistas cada año.

• A únicamente 15 minutos de Jacó, donde encontrará restaurantes, supermercados, comercios, centros médicos, entretenimiento y una vibrante vida nocturna.

• A 25 minutos de Esterillos, un encantador destino costero conocido por sus playas tranquilas y excelentes olas para surfear.

POTENCIAL DE DESARROLLO

• Segregar la propiedad en aproximadamente cinco lotes de 5.000 m², todos con vista al mar.

• Desarrollar un exclusivo retiro de bienestar, yoga o ecoturismo con eco-cabañas y espacios rodeados de naturaleza.

• Construir un complejo de villas de lujo para alquiler vacacional de alta rentabilidad.

• Desarrollar una comunidad residencial privada o una impresionante finca con total privacidad.

Con sus espectaculares vistas al océano, excelente acceso por carretera asfaltada, disponibilidad de servicios básicos, precio altamente competitivo y múltiples opciones de desarrollo, esta propiedad representa una oportunidad única para invertir en una de las zonas con mayor proyección del Pacífico Central de Costa Rica.

content.body:
Welcome to Croc’s Casino Resort 1541, a beautifully furnished 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath oceanfront condo located on the 15th floor of one of Jaco Beach’s premier resort properties. Measuring 1,388 square feet, this residence offers expansive, direct ocean views from the living area, balcony, and both bedrooms.

Designed for comfort, style, and effortless coastal living, the condo features central A/C, a spacious open-concept living area, and an oceanfront balcony furnished with two tables and four chairs. It is the ideal place to relax, entertain, and enjoy unforgettable sunsets over the Pacific Ocean.

Both bedrooms face the ocean and include ensuite bathrooms. The master suite features a king-size bed, dual bathroom vanities, and a bathtub surrounded by custom woodwork. The second bedroom also includes a king-size bed and private bath. A convenient half bathroom is located near the entry.

The full-size kitchen is finished with granite countertops and stainless steel Whirlpool appliances, offering everything needed for full-time living or vacation rental use. A separate laundry room includes a Whirlpool washer and dryer, and this residence also features a rare bonus for a two-bedroom condo at Croc’s: a large pantry that measures 6.8’x 6.4’.

Croc’s 1541 is being offered tastefully furnished and includes beautiful Central American artwork, two custom-made full-length mirrors, teakwood benches in both showers, and smart TVs in the living area and both bedrooms. The condo has had only one set of owners since the building was delivered in 2015 and has never been rented. It has been meticulously maintained and is in excellent condition, ready for immediate personal use or as an Airbnb-style vacation rental investment.

Located on the peaceful north end of Jaco Beach, Costa Rica, Croc’s Casino Resort offers a true resort lifestyle with a Las Vegas-style casino, sports bar, spectacular oceanfront pool with waterslide, poolside restaurant, coffee shop, Mexican restaurant, upscale Mediterranean restaurant, gym, convenience store, and spa.

With its direct oceanfront position, spacious layout, high-quality furnishings, and prime resort setting, Croc’s Casino Resort 1541 is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready beachfront residence in one of Jaco’s most desirable destinations.

properties.title: Riverfront lot near Jaco
properties.author: Christopher Kogel

content.body:
Riverfront lot near Jaco

Nestled along the scenic road to Bijagual and just 15 minutes from Jacó Beach, this exceptional property offers the perfect balance of convenience, privacy, and natural beauty. Ideally situated between the main access road and a tranquil river, the property is surrounded by lush tropical forest, creating a peaceful sanctuary immersed in Costa Rica’s rich biodiversity.

Towering trees, vibrant vegetation, and the soothing sounds of flowing water provide an idyllic setting for those seeking a connection with nature. Wildlife is abundant, with colorful birds, monkeys, and other native species frequently visiting the area, making every day feel like a retreat in the rainforest.

The property’s strategic location provides easy year-round access while maintaining a secluded atmosphere rarely found so close to Jacó. Whether envisioned as a private residence, eco-lodge, wellness retreat, vacation rental development, or investment property, the land offers endless possibilities in one of Costa Rica’s fastest-growing regions.

Enjoy the best of both worlds: the convenience of nearby beaches, restaurants, shopping, and services in Jacó, combined with the serenity of a riverfront setting surrounded by pristine forest. With the renowned Bijagual area and its spectacular waterfalls nearby, outdoor adventures and natural attractions are always within reach.

This unique property presents a rare opportunity to create your dream project in a tranquil tropical environment, just minutes from the vibrant Pacific Coast lifestyle that makes Costa Rica famous worldwide.

Ubicada sobre la pintoresca carretera hacia Bijagual y a tan solo 15 minutos de Playa Jacó, esta extraordinaria propiedad ofrece la combinación perfecta entre comodidad, privacidad y belleza natural. Estratégicamente situada entre la carretera principal y un tranquilo río, la propiedad está rodeada de exuberante bosque tropical, creando un santuario natural inmerso en la rica biodiversidad de Costa Rica.

Majestuosos árboles, abundante vegetación y el relajante sonido del agua fluyendo brindan un entorno único para quienes buscan una conexión auténtica con la naturaleza. La vida silvestre es abundante, con aves tropicales, monos y otras especies nativas que visitan frecuentemente la zona, convirtiendo cada día en una experiencia de selva tropical.

La ubicación privilegiada de la propiedad permite un acceso fácil durante todo el año, manteniendo al mismo tiempo una sensación de tranquilidad y aislamiento difícil de encontrar tan cerca de Jacó. Ya sea para desarrollar una residencia privada, un eco-lodge, un centro de bienestar, un proyecto de alquiler vacacional o una inversión inmobiliaria, esta propiedad ofrece un sinfín de posibilidades.

Disfrute de lo mejor de ambos mundos: la cercanía a las playas, restaurantes, comercios y servicios de Jacó, junto con la serenidad de un entorno natural rodeado de bosque y bordeado por un río cristalino. Además, la reconocida zona de Bijagual y sus impresionantes cascadas se encuentran a pocos minutos, ofreciendo acceso a algunas de las maravillas naturales más espectaculares del Pacífico Central.

Esta propiedad representa una oportunidad única para desarrollar el proyecto de sus sueños en un entorno tropical privilegiado, a pocos minutos del vibrante estilo de vida costero que ha convertido a Costa Rica en uno de los destinos más deseados del mundo.

Discover the perfect blend of comfort, style, and investment potential in this new beautiful modern home located just 1.5 km from Playa Hermosa, one of Costa Rica’s most sought-after beach destinations. Situated on a generous 5,274 sq. ft. lot, this property offers ample space for future expansions, making it ideal as a primary residence, vacation home, or income-producing vacation rental.

The home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including a private ensuite bathroom in the primary bedroom. Fine wood doors throughout the residence and large glass doors in every bedroom to create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living, filling the home with natural light.

The heart of the home is the kitchen, thoughtfully designed with premium porcelain finishes, a large central island, built-in trash bins, spice rack, backsplash, and quality sink—perfect for entertaining family and guests.

Comfort is guaranteed year-round with inverter air conditioning throughout the entire home, ceiling fans in all areas, and hot water available throughout the property.

Step outside to your private tropical oasis featuring a pool with a waterfall, a spacious terrace with direct pool access, and plenty of outdoor space to relax or entertain. Additional features include parking for up to six vehicles, an electric gate, smart locks, water reserve tank, and a convenient storage/laundry room.

Renowned for its stunning natural beauty, world-class surfing, and breathtaking Pacific sunsets, Playa Hermosa is a favorite destination for families, outdoor enthusiasts, and beach lovers alike. The area provides a relaxed coastal lifestyle while being just 5 minutes from Jacó Beach, where you’ll find a wide variety of restaurants, cafés, shops, supermarkets, medical services, nightlife, and entertainment.

Whether you’re looking for a full-time residence, a profitable Airbnb investment, or a vacation retreat near the beach, this property offers exceptional value in one of Costa Rica’s fastest-growing real estate markets.

Situada en un amplio lote de 490 m², esta propiedad ofrece espacio suficiente para futuras ampliaciones, convirtiéndola en una opción ideal como residencia principal, casa de vacaciones o propiedad para generar ingresos mediante alquileres vacacionales.

From the upper level, enjoy beautiful ocean views and the sound of the waves just beyond the soccer field. This is one of the closest fee-simple titled properties to the beach in Bejuco — any closer to the shoreline typically requires a government concession lease.

The home comes with the furniture and appliances on site.  There is a 6 video camera system mounted on the home and a back up water tank with filters and a pump to ensure the home has even pressure and clear water available.  The front gate is electric and operates by remote control.  And there are three new septic systems in place.

Bejuco continues to grow in popularity thanks to its wide sandy beach, relaxed atmosphere, and convenient location along Costa Rica’s Central Pacific coast. Just minutes away, Esterillos Town Center Plaza offers restaurants, cafés, shops, and emergency car center and essential services. Nearby Parrita provides supermarkets, banks, hardware stores, and additional conveniences, while the world-famous Manuel Antonio and Quepos are only about 30 minutes south. Heading west, you’ll find Esterillos and the vibrant beach town of Jaco, known for its nightlife, casinos, dining, and entertainment. Despite being close to everything, this property still feels peaceful and private. San José International Airport is approximately two hours away, making travel easy and convenient.

	•	Two-family living — share the property with parents, adult children, or close friends while maintaining complete privacy

Both units feature open-concept living spaces, soaring ceilings, and premium finishes throughout — including sintered stone countertops and custom natural wood cabinetry. Your Private Pool — 7m x 3m (23 ft x 10 ft)

Step outside and into your own private pool measuring 7 meters x 3 meters (23 ft x 10 ft) — a generous size ideal for swimming laps, entertaining guests, or simply cooling off after a morning surf session at Playa Hermosa. The pool area flows naturally into the lakefront terrace, creating an outdoor living space that feels like a private resort.

Lakefront Living with a Private Dock

The property sits directly on one of Místico’s iconic navigable lakes, complete with a private dock — perfect for fishing from your backyard, launching kayaks at sunrise, or simply watching the tropical wildlife from your own slice of waterfront. This combination of a private pool AND lakefront access is exceptionally rare in the community.

Outdoor & Infrastructure Highlights

	•	Private pool: 7m x 3m / 23 ft x 10 ft

	•	Lakefront lot with private dock — kayak, fish, or relax at the water’s edge

	•	Two-car covered garage

	•	Spacious laundry room

	•	Spacious storage room — ideal for beach gear, bikes, kayaks, and sports equipment

	•	Advanced treatment plant with E-One system — modern, environmentally responsible waste management

	•	Automated garden irrigation system — keeps the tropical landscaping lush with minimal effort

Life Inside Místico — A One-of-a-Kind Beach Community

Místico is not just an address — it’s a master-planned coastal lifestyle community spanning 865 acres along Playa Hermosa, between Jacó and Esterillos on Costa Rica’s Central Pacific coast. As a resident of Casa Nabia, you enjoy access to:

	•	Direct beach access to Playa Hermosa — one of the world’s top surf breaks

	•	150+ acres of navigable freshwater lakes for swimming, paddling, fishing, and kayaking

	•	30+ miles of pedestrian, cycling, and equestrian trails through tropical forests and waterways

	•	24/7 security with controlled community access

	•	Madresal Beach Club, Aire Sports Club, O Social Club, and Campo Equestrian Club — four distinct member clubs

	•	Home to Costa Rica’s largest sea turtle reserve

	•	High-speed fiber optic internet — built for remote workers

	•	Planned boutique hotels, organic farm, bilingual school, restaurants, and two town centers

Location — The Sweet Spot of the Central Pacific

Located in Playa Hermosa de Jacó, Místico places you minutes from the restaurants, shops, and nightlife of Jacó, while keeping you immersed in nature. San José is approximately 90 minutes away. This is the Central Pacific’s most talked-about address for a reason.

Casa Nabia #6 at Místico is one of the few duplex opportunities available in this community — and with a private pool, lakefront positioning, and a private dock, it is genuinely one of a kind. Properties with this combination of flexibility, finishes, and location do not last long in this market.

content.body:
Discover Casa Cedro, an exclusive 4-bedroom panoramic ocean view villa located in Mar a Mar Caletas, one of the most sought-after gated communities near Jacó Beach and Herradura. Positioned at the end of a private ridge, this luxury home offers panoramic Pacific Ocean views, privacy, and high-end finishes.

This newly built two-level villa features 1,858 sq. ft. of interior living space, 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and spacious terraces perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The living space opens seamlessly onto a spacious terrace featuring a Jacuzzi, where you can take in breathtaking ocean and mountain views. Serene and private, this outdoor retreat is often graced by macaws visiting the trees just in front, creating a truly unique tropical experience.

Offered fully furnished and move-in ready, it’s ready to enjoy from day one.

Mar a Mar amenities include:

•	24-hour gated security

•	Ocean-view gym

•	Resort-style pool

•	Two jacuzzis, including one with an infinity-edge and direct ocean view

•	BBQ rancho for social gatherings

•	Pets park and children’s playground

•	Open-air yoga deck

•	Coworking space for digital nomads

Located minutes from Jaco Beach and Los Sueños Resort and Marina and next to the iconic Villa Caletas Hotel, this property combines luxury real estate, ocean views, and prime location on Costa Rica’s Central Pacific coast.

Ideal for rentals, families, friends and digital nomads, this property offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. Casa Cedro is an exceptional opportunity for those seeking refined coastal living, spectacular views, and exclusivity in one of Costa Rica’s most desirable destinations—schedule your private showing and experience it in person.

El área social se abre de forma fluida hacia una espaciosa terraza con jacuzzi, desde donde podrá disfrutar de espectaculares vistas al mar y la montaña. Ideal para rentas vacacionales, familias, amigos y nómadas digitales, esta propiedad ofrece el equilibrio perfecto entre confort, conveniencia y estilo de vida. properties.title: Off-Grid Luxury Living | Financing
properties.author: Timothygiannone

content.body:
Off-Grid Luxury Living | Financing

Cerro Fresco Oceanview Estate | 5,500 Sq Ft | Off-Grid Luxury Living in Playa Hermosa

Perched in the highly sought-after Cerro Fresco community of Playa Hermosa, this impressive three-story estate offers approximately 5,500 sq ft of construction, designed to capture breathtaking ocean and jungle views from nearly every level. On clear days, enjoy panoramic vistas stretching all the way to Manuel Antonio.

This 4-bedroom, 7-bathroom residence is built for both comfort and entertaining, featuring expansive exterior patios that seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor living—perfect for taking in the cool breezes and serene surroundings that define Cerro Fresco.

Inside, the home showcases high-end appliances and premium finishes throughout, combining modern design with functionality. This is also the first ICF (Insulated Concrete Form) home in the area, offering superior insulation, energy efficiency, and durability.

Designed for complete independence and sustainability, the property is fully off-grid and powered by an advanced solar system featuring 60 panels paired with a 60KW battery. The entire system is fully integrated and easily controlled from your smartphone, providing seamless energy management.

Comfort is further enhanced by two high-efficiency 2-ton, 18 SEER Innovair inverter AC systems that operate efficiently within the solar setup, delivering both performance and cost savings.

This is a rare opportunity to own a luxury home that combines cutting-edge technology, energy independence, and some of the most spectacular views on the Central Pacific coast.

For more information or to schedule a private showing, please contact us.

Off-Grid Luxury Living | Financing

Finca con Vista al Mar en Cerro Fresco | 510 m² | Vida de Lujo Autosuficiente en Playa Hermosa

Ubicada en la codiciada comunidad de Cerro Fresco en Playa Hermosa, esta impresionante propiedad de tres niveles ofrece aproximadamente 510 m² de construcción, diseñada para capturar espectaculares vistas al océano y la selva desde casi todos sus niveles. En días despejados, podrá disfrutar de vistas panorámicas que se extienden hasta Manuel Antonio.

Esta residencia cuenta con 4 habitaciones y 7 baños, y ha sido diseñada tanto para el confort como para el entretenimiento. Dispone de amplias terrazas exteriores que integran perfectamente los espacios interiores y exteriores, ideales para disfrutar de las frescas brisas y el entorno natural que caracteriza a Cerro Fresco.

En su interior, la propiedad presenta electrodomésticos de alta gama y acabados premium en todas sus áreas, combinando diseño moderno con funcionalidad. Además, es la primera vivienda construida con sistema ICF (Formas de Concreto Aislado) en la zona, lo que ofrece una mayor eficiencia energética, aislamiento superior y durabilidad.

Pensada para una total independencia y sostenibilidad, la propiedad es completamente autosuficiente (off-grid) y funciona con un avanzado sistema solar que incluye 60 paneles junto con una batería de 60KW. Todo el sistema está completamente integrado y puede ser controlado fácilmente desde su teléfono inteligente, permitiendo una gestión energética eficiente y sin complicaciones.

El confort se complementa con dos sistemas de aire acondicionado inverter Innovair de alta eficiencia, de 2 toneladas y 18 SEER, que operan de manera eficiente dentro del sistema solar, ofreciendo excelente rendimiento y ahorro energético.

Esta es una oportunidad única de adquirir una propiedad de lujo que combina tecnología de vanguardia, independencia energética y algunas de las vistas más espectaculares del Pacífico Central.

Para más información o para agendar una visita privada, no dude en contactarnos.

content.body:
Casa Espavel is a brand new 5-bedroom home located in the gated community of Costa Esterillos, just a five-minute drive from Esterillos Oeste Beach. Each spacious bedroom features its own private bathroom, plus the home includes an additional half bathroom for guests. Designed for comfort and style, the open-concept layout seamlessly blends the modern kitchen with the living area, creating the perfect space for entertaining and family gatherings.

Floor-to-ceiling glass windows and large sliding doors fill the home with natural light and open completely to a generous terrace featuring a BBQ area and private pool, all surrounded by lush trees for maximum privacy. Enjoy the wonderful breeze, abundant birdlife, and the peaceful sounds of nature.

The home showcases beautiful high cedar wood ceilings, cedar wood beds and doors, and comes fully furnished with top-of-the-line furniture and appliances. Air conditioning throughout ensures year-round comfort. With capacity to host up to 14 people comfortably, Casa Espavel is ideal as a luxury family retreat, vacation rental, or investment opportunity.

The 3,294 sq.ft house sits on a spacious 0,58 acre lot, offering privacy, room to expand, and a beautiful natural setting surrounded by trees. Additional features include a 10,000-liter water reserve tank, spacious parking, a dedicated laundry room, extra storage space and easy access throughout the property for comfortable everyday living. Safe, private, and move-in ready, this stunning Costa Esterillos residence offers the perfect blend of luxury, nature, and convenience.

Conveniently located near Esterillos Town Center, you’ll find restaurants, a supermarket, coffee shop, and gas station just minutes away. Its central location makes it ideal for exploring the area, enjoying surfing in Esterillos, taking nearby adventure tours, or visiting Manuel Antonio National Park. Jaco Beach and all its dining, shopping, and entertainment are only a 20-minute drive away.

Discover everything Casa Espavel has to offer and schedule your private showing today at this spectacular Costa Esterillos property.

Casa Espavel es una casa completamente nueva de 5 habitaciones ubicada en la comunidad privada Costa Esterillos, a solo cinco minutos en carro de Playa Esterillos Oeste. Cada amplia habitación cuenta con su propio baño privado, además la casa incluye un medio baño adicional para visitas. Diseñada para brindar comodidad y estilo, su distribución de concepto abierto integra perfectamente la moderna cocina con la sala, creando el espacio ideal para reuniones familiares y entretenimiento.

Las ventanas de vidrio de piso a techo y las amplias puertas corredizas llenan la casa de luz natural y se abren por completo hacia una espaciosa terraza con área de BBQ y piscina privada, todo rodeado de exuberantes árboles que brindan máxima privacidad. Disfrute de la maravillosa brisa, del canto de los pájaros y los tranquilos sonidos de la naturaleza.

La propiedad destaca por sus hermosos cielos altos de madera de cedro, así como las camas y puertas también de madera de cedro. Completamente amueblada con muebles y electrodomésticos de primera línea. Aire acondicionado en toda la casa garantiza confort durante todo el año. Con capacidad para hospedar cómodamente hasta 14 personas, Casa Espavel es ideal como retiro familiar privado, alquiler vacacional u oportunidad de inversión.

La casa de 306 m2 se encuentra en un amplio lote de 2334 m2, ofreciendo privacidad, espacio para expandirse y un hermoso entorno natural rodeado de árboles. Entre sus características adicionales se incluyen un tanque de reserva de agua de 10.000 litros, amplio estacionamiento, cuarto de lavandería independiente, bodega y fácil acceso en toda la propiedad para una vida diaria cómoda. Segura, privada y lista para habitar, esta impresionante residencia en Costa Esterillos ofrece la combinación perfecta de lujo, naturaleza y conveniencia.

Convenientemente ubicada cerca del centro comercial Town Center de Esterillos, encontrará restaurantes, supermercado, cafetería y gasolinera a solo minutos de distancia. Su ubicación central la hace ideal para explorar la zona, disfrutar del surf en Esterillos, realizar tours de aventura cercanos o visitar el Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio. Playa Jacó, con su oferta gastronómica, tiendas y entretenimiento, se encuentra a solo 20 minutos en carro.

Descubra todo lo que Casa Espavel tiene para ofrecer y coordine hoy mismo su visita privada a esta espectacular propiedad en Costa Esterillos.

properties.author: Timothygiannone

content.body:
Modern Oceanview Designer Retreat

This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers a seamless blend of modern design and natural beauty, with stunning ocean and mountain views as your daily backdrop. Completely redesigned by a local interior designer, the residence has been transformed into a stylish, move-in-ready space where every detail feels intentional and refined.

The interior showcases high-quality contemporary finishes throughout, including large-format porcelain tile flooring, custom built-ins with a warm wood-grain aesthetic, and elegant Taj Mahal porcelain slab countertops. The design is elevated with a thoughtful mix of brushed bronze accents in the kitchen and brushed nickel finishes in the bathrooms, creating a sophisticated yet inviting atmosphere.

The Modern Oceanview Designer Retreat offers comfort and efficiency at the forefront, with brand-new Daikin high-efficiency inverter air conditioning systems and premium appliances installed throughout. New Acari sliding glass doors and windows feature advanced UV filtering technology, reducing up to 99% of UV rays and 45% of heat—helping maintain a cool interior while keeping energy costs low.

The condo is offered fully furnished and tastefully decorated, featuring a curated blend of mid-century and organic modern style. A neutral palette is complemented by handcrafted furniture from Costa Rican artisans, coastal-inspired artwork, and vibrant tropical plants, creating a calm and welcoming living environment.

Located within a secure, gated community, residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds and access to a large central swimming pool. The property is just a short walk to the beach, as well as nearby grocery stores and restaurants, making everyday living both convenient and enjoyable.

Whether you’re seeking a full-time residence or a high-performing rental property, this condo is thoughtfully equipped with everything needed for immediate use or Airbnb income potential.

Ideally positioned for both relaxation and adventure, the location provides easy access to renowned destinations such as Manuel Antonio National Park, the Nauyaca Waterfalls in Dominical, scenic jungle trails, and popular surf spots like Playa Hermosa—making it the perfect base to experience the best of Costa Rica’s central Pacific coast.

_____________________________________________________________________________

Refugio Moderno de Diseño con Vista al Mar

Este hermoso condominio de 2 dormitorios y 2 baños, completamente renovado, ofrece una combinación perfecta de diseño moderno y belleza natural, con impresionantes vistas al océano y a las montañas como telón de fondo diario. Rediseñado por un talentoso diseñador de interiores local, la residencia ha sido transformada en un espacio elegante, listo para habitar, donde cada detalle ha sido cuidadosamente pensado y ejecutado.

El interior destaca por sus acabados contemporáneos de alta calidad, incluyendo pisos de porcelanato de gran formato, muebles empotrados personalizados con estética tipo madera y elegantes encimeras de porcelana tipo Taj Mahal. El diseño se realza con una combinación armoniosa de detalles en bronce cepillado en la cocina y acabados en níquel cepillado en los baños, creando un ambiente sofisticado y acogedor.

El Refugio Moderno de Diseño con Vista al Mar prioriza la comodidad y la eficiencia, con sistemas de aire acondicionado Daikin inverter de alta eficiencia completamente nuevos y electrodomésticos de primera calidad instalados en toda la propiedad. Las nuevas puertas corredizas y ventanas Acari cuentan con tecnología avanzada de filtrado UV, reduciendo hasta el 99% de los rayos ultravioleta y el 45% del calor, lo que ayuda a mantener un ambiente fresco y a reducir los costos de energía.

El condominio se ofrece completamente amueblado y decorado con excelente gusto, incorporando una cuidada mezcla de estilo moderno orgánico y de mediados de siglo. Una paleta neutra se complementa con muebles artesanales elaborados por artesanos costarricenses, obras de arte inspiradas en la costa y vibrantes plantas tropicales, creando un entorno tranquilo y acogedor.

Ubicado dentro de una comunidad cerrada y segura, los residentes disfrutan de áreas comunes impecablemente mantenidas y acceso a una amplia piscina central. La propiedad se encuentra a pocos minutos caminando de la playa, supermercados y restaurantes, brindando comodidad y estilo de vida en un solo lugar.

Ya sea que esté buscando una residencia permanente o una propiedad con alto rendimiento para alquiler, este condominio está completamente equipado para uso inmediato o como inversión en Airbnb.

Idealmente ubicado tanto para el descanso como para la aventura, la propiedad ofrece fácil acceso a destinos reconocidos como el Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio, las Cataratas Nauyaca en Dominical, senderos en la selva y populares playas de surf como Playa Hermosa, convirtiéndolo en el punto de partida perfecto para disfrutar lo mejor del Pacífico Central de Costa Rica.

content.body:
Luxury modern condo | Lush green views

Welcome to this luxury modern condo in Jaco Bay, a beautifully reimagined 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo that blends modern luxury with the tranquility of nature. Fully renovated by a talented local interior designer, this turnkey residence offers a fresh, sophisticated living experience with every detail thoughtfully curated.

From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by expansive views of lush greenery, mountains, and the vibrant natural surroundings—including frequent visits from colorful macaws—all overlooking the resort-style pool. The open living space is bright, airy, and designed for both relaxation and entertaining.

The condo features brand-new Daikin high-efficiency inverter air conditioning units, all controllable via a smartphone app, along with top-of-the-line appliances that enhance both comfort and energy efficiency, keeping utility costs low.

High-end contemporary finishes are showcased throughout, including large-format porcelain tile flooring, custom wood-grain built-ins with elegant paneling, stunning Calacatta Gold porcelain slab countertops, and sleek brushed nickel accents. Every element has been selected to create a clean, modern aesthetic with warmth and character.

The furnishings and décor are a tasteful blend of mid-century and organic modern design. A neutral palette is complemented by handcrafted pieces from Costa Rican artisans, coastal-inspired artwork, and live tropical plants, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere.

Offered fully furnished and equipped, this condo is truly move-in ready and also presents an excellent opportunity as a high-performing Airbnb or rental investment.

Located within a secure, gated community, Jaco Bay offers beautifully maintained grounds and access to a large central swimming pool. The property is ideally situated within walking distance to the beach, grocery stores, and a variety of restaurants, placing everything you need just steps away.

Perfect for beach lovers and adventure seekers alike, this location also provides easy access to some of Costa Rica’s most iconic destinations, including Manuel Antonio National Park, the Nauyaca Waterfalls in Dominical, and nearby jungle trails, waterfalls, and surf beaches like Playa Hermosa.

This luxury modern condo is the perfect combination of style, comfort, and location—an exceptional opportunity to own a fully upgraded condo in one of Jaco’s most desirable communities.

______________________________________________________________________________

Condominio moderno de lujo | Vistas verdes exuberantes

Bienvenido a este condominio moderno de lujo en Jaco Bay, una propiedad de 2 dormitorios y 2 baños completamente renovada que combina el lujo contemporáneo con la tranquilidad de la naturaleza. Rediseñado por un talentoso diseñador de interiores local, esta residencia lista para habitar ofrece una experiencia sofisticada y fresca, con cada detalle cuidadosamente seleccionado.

Desde el momento en que ingresa, es recibido por amplias vistas de exuberante vegetación, montañas y el vibrante entorno natural, incluyendo la frecuente visita de coloridas guacamayas, todo con vista a la piscina estilo resort. El espacio de sala y comedor de concepto abierto es luminoso, ventilado y perfecto tanto para relajarse como para entretener.

El condominio cuenta con unidades de aire acondicionado Daikin inverter de alta eficiencia completamente nuevas, controlables mediante una aplicación móvil, además de electrodomésticos de alta gama que mejoran tanto la comodidad como la eficiencia energética, manteniendo bajos los costos de electricidad.

Los acabados contemporáneos de alta calidad se destacan en toda la propiedad, incluyendo pisos de porcelanato de gran formato, muebles empotrados con acabado tipo madera y paneles personalizados, elegantes encimeras de porcelana tipo Calacatta Gold y accesorios en níquel cepillado. Cada elemento ha sido seleccionado para crear una estética moderna, limpia y acogedora.

El mobiliario y la decoración combinan de manera armoniosa el estilo moderno orgánico con influencias de mediados de siglo. Una paleta neutra se complementa con piezas artesanales de artesanos costarricenses, arte inspirado en la costa y plantas tropicales vivas, creando un ambiente sereno y acogedor.

Se ofrece completamente amueblado y equipado, listo para habitar de inmediato, y también representa una excelente oportunidad como inversión para alquiler tipo Airbnb de alto rendimiento.

Ubicado dentro de una comunidad cerrada y segura, Jaco Bay ofrece áreas comunes bien mantenidas y acceso a una amplia piscina central. La propiedad se encuentra a poca distancia caminando de la playa, supermercados y una variedad de restaurantes, brindándole todo lo necesario a solo pasos.

Perfecto para amantes de la playa y la aventura, esta ubicación también ofrece fácil acceso a algunos de los destinos más icónicos de Costa Rica, incluyendo el Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio, las Cataratas Nauyaca en Dominical, así como senderos en la selva, otras cascadas y playas cercanas como la famosa Playa Hermosa.

Este condominio moderno de lujo representa la combinación perfecta de estilo, confort y ubicación, una oportunidad excepcional para adquirir una propiedad completamente renovada en una de las comunidades más deseadas de Jacó.

properties.title: Two Luxury Homes with Ocean Views | Prime Expansion Potential | Legal Well
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
This property features not one but two of the best ocean views on the central Pacific Coast of Costa Rica!  Watch the sunrise over Hermosa beach in one home and the sunset across the street in another!  There are two luxury casitas with a strong Airbnb rental history, plus a separate, equally elegant apartment for family, guests, or live-in staff. This is a turnkey investment in one of Playa Hermosa’s most desirable communities.

Located in Vista Lapas, a private enclave above Calle Hermosa in Playa Hermosa de Jacó (Garabito, Puntarenas), the property enjoys sweeping ocean and mountain views and is thoughtfully designed for comfort, privacy, and indoor-outdoor living.  There is a paverstone road stretching all the way to the ridgeline where these homes are perched with a private, remote controlled gate at the bottom, keeping the neighborhood private.

The estate includes two independent residences, each with its own entrance and motorized gate:

Sunrise Home: A spacious 2-bedroom / 1-bath luxury home with an office, garage, private pool, and full-size laundry room.

Sunset Home: A 2-bedroom / 1-bath luxury home with a separate 1-bedroom / 1-bath apartment on the lower level—ideal for added rental income or guest accommodations. This residence also features a private pool and full-size laundry.

The homes are strategically positioned to showcase two distinct coastal experiences. The “Sunrise” Casita faces south toward Punta Mala and Esterillos, capturing spectacular sunrise views and uninterrupted vistas of the waves along Playa Hermosa. The “Sunset” Casita faces west over Valle Perdido, offering dramatic sunset views and a tranquil, elevated pool setting that delivers a true resort-style atmosphere in a peaceful mountain environment.

Set on an expansive 13,750 m² lot, the property offers ample room to build a larger main residence or additional rental units. The existing homes were intentionally placed to preserve both privacy and ocean views for future construction. A standout feature is the legal private well with approved concession, providing valuable long-term infrastructure and peace of mind.

Completed in 2024 and designed by Christopher Powell (Studio 133), the architecture showcases clean modern lines with a strong emphasis on natural light, views, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Secure, private, and perched above Playa Hermosa near Jacó, this is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey, multi-unit ocean-view property within one of the area’s most sought-after gated communities.

Both homes come with the custom furniture and appliances on site, ready to enjoy or rent.

Schedule your tour today!

properties.title: 19 Costa Esterillos | Pool | Great Location | Well Appointed
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Welcome to home #19 in Costa Esterillos Estates.  This home has been owned by a North American Businessman and his wife and used as their full time residence.  They have solved all the little inconveniences that come with living in Costa Rica.  The home has a back up diesel generator that turns on automatically when the lights go out!  It also has a 5000 liter back-up water tank and complete filtration system, water is drinkable from any faucet in the home.  They have redundant internet services, including Star Link which will convey with the purchase.  There is an exterior lighting system that turns on automatically at night as well.

The home is in the guarded community of Costa Esterillos Estates and is the closest home to the guard entrance, at the beginning of the community.  There are currently no neighboring houses and the pool located in the huge back yard is surrounded by Costa Rica’s tropical forest.  Monkeys and colorful birds visit the property daily, skinny dipping allowed.

Light abounds in indoor spaces via the huge windows throughout, offering views of the gardens and forest from every angle.  There are four bedrooms, three with en-suite bathrooms and the master has a jacuzzi tub and double vanity.  There is a living room upstairs that can be converted to a 5th bedroom or gym.  The downstairs living space is made for entertaining.  With a dining table for 8 and open living room with a sectional sofa and 100″ 8k television, perfect for watching sports or a good movie with your honey.

There is a well appointed kitchen with island with a stainless steel sink and appliances.  There is also a separate laundry room inside the home with full size washer and drier.  There’s an extra fridge in the wet bar by the pool, and the home comes with all furniture as well, including a tv in every bedroom!

Outdoor living space abounds with a social area in front, a covered living space on the middle deck, multiple decks and balconies off the bedrooms and a party pool area complete with multiple bars, dining table, two covered lounge areas and infinity edge pool.

There is much more to enjoy, so schedule your tour today and come see this “North American standard” all concrete construction home you can call your own.

One-Level, Accessible Home in Ciudad del Mar | Walk to Jacó Beach

This exceptionally well-maintained, single-level home is located in the gated community of Ciudad del Mar, within Jacó city limits—offering comfort, accessibility, and a location that’s hard to beat.

What truly sets this home apart from others in the neighborhood is the thoughtful list of owner-installed upgrades and functional improvements that enhance both livability and long-term value. The home features a double concrete carport, keyless entry, and whole-ceiling insulation, providing better energy efficiency and interior comfort. The living area ceiling has been fully drywalled and sealed, a notable upgrade not found in many comparable homes.

The primary suite includes an accessible en-suite bathroom and a custom drawer bank in the master closet for improved storage and organization. The kitchen is enhanced with upgraded cabinetry and a dedicated pantry, offering increased functionality for full-time living.

Outdoor living is equally well thought out, with an extended backyard patio ideal for relaxing or entertaining, plus an exterior storage cabinet for added convenience.

Additional highlights include:

* One-level, handicap-accessible layout

* Double concrete carport

* Accessible en-suite bathroom

* Keyless entry system

* Ceiling insulation throughout the home

* Upgraded, sealed living-area ceiling

* Extended backyard patio

* Custom storage in primary closet

* Kitchen with upgraded pantry cabinetry

* Exterior storage cabinet

This home has never been used as a rental and has been owned and meticulously cared for by the original owners, making it a rare find in this community.

Ciudad del Mar offers resort-style amenities, security, and a lifestyle that lets you walk to Jacó Beach or take a quick golf cart ride—with the golf cart negotiable with the asking price.

Located in the highly desirable Ciudad del Mar community, this property offers not only a well-maintained, single-story home but also access to some of the best resort-style amenities in Jacó—making it an excellent option for both full-time living and rental potential.

Ciudad del Mar is known for its thoughtfully designed common areas, including multiple swimming pools (main pool, lap pool, and kids pool), a spacious rancho-style clubhouse, BBQ areas, outdoor showers, and comfortable lounge spaces ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

For health and wellness, residents enjoy a fully equipped gym and an open-air yoga deck surrounded by lush greenery.

The community also offers a wide range of recreational amenities, including tennis and pickleball courts, a basketball court, beach volleyball, a mini soccer field, mini golf, and walking and biking trails throughout the development.

Designed with both families and vacationers in mind, Ciudad del Mar features a children’s playground, safe walkable streets, and a welcoming environment for all ages.

Additional highlights include 24/7 gated security with controlled access, a location just a short walk to the beach (approximately 400 meters), and close proximity to downtown Jacó’s restaurants, shops, and services.

This property was featured in the Inaugural Relocation Bus Tour in Spring of 2026, highlighting Jacó Beach living and Costa Rica relocation opportunities.

Contact me today to schedule a private showing—homes with this level of upgrades, accessibility, and location do not last.

Here, luxury, peace, and modern elegance come together to create a space where every day feels like a getaway. Layout and Interior Design

As you step onto the first floor, you are immediately welcomed by a spacious living area that sets the tone for relaxed luxury. Warm wood details soften the modern, neutral décor, creating an atmosphere that feels both stylish and welcoming. This space flows seamlessly into the dining area and an expansive, fully equipped kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances—perfect for everything from casual breakfasts to unforgettable gourmet dinners shared with loved ones. A TV in the living room completes the space, making it ideal for cozy movie nights or peaceful evenings at home.

The second floor is dedicated to rest, privacy, and rejuvenation. It features eight beautifully designed bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, offering comfort and convenience for family and guests alike. The master suite is a true retreat, featuring a private balcony with stunning pool views—an inspiring place to start your day with coffee or unwind as the evening sets in.

Outdoor Features and Amenities

Casa Sundeck truly shines outdoors, where the lifestyle of Jacó comes alive. The impressive 6 x 12-meter swimming pool is surrounded by a spacious sun deck, inviting you to relax, recharge, and enjoy Costa Rica’s warm climate year-round. Outdoor bathrooms near the pool add an extra level of comfort and practicality.

Designed for memorable moments, the open-air rancho with BBQ area is ideal for entertaining, celebrations, and relaxed gatherings with family and friends. With parking available for up to five vehicles, hosting guests is always easy and stress-free.

content.body:
Tropical Retreat with Main Home, Pool, and Income-Producing Rental Units in Playa Hermosa

Discover a one-of-a-kind tropical oasis nestled in the lush hills of Playa Hermosa, just 10 minutes from Jacó and 1.5 hours from San José. Surrounded by vibrant jungle and abundant wildlife, this private estate offers a true Pura Vida lifestyle with the added benefit of multiple income-producing rental units.

The main residence features a spacious open-concept layout that blends indoor and outdoor living. The large primary bedroom includes its own en-suite bathroom, while the expansive kitchen, living, and dining area create a warm and inviting environment for entertaining or relaxing. A convenient half bath completes the main home.

Across the stunning central pool—an impressive focal point that separates the living spaces—you’ll find three charming rental units. Two elevated treehouse-style casitas offer guests an immersive jungle experience, while the larger two-bedroom unit including a shared  bathroom, making it ideal for longer stays or visiting family. All units are surrounded by lush gardens, tropical flowers, and mature trees that attract monkeys, toucans, scarlet macaws, and other local wildlife. Caretakers suite on-site.

This property is perfectly designed for those seeking tranquility, privacy, and connection with nature. Whether used as a private residence with guest accommodations or as a turnkey income-generating retreat, the setting captures the essence of Costa Rica’s coastal lifestyle.

A rare opportunity to own an authentic haven in one of the most desirable areas of the Central Pacific. Embrace the peaceful surroundings, enjoy the natural beauty that envelops the property, and experience the true meaning of Pura Vida.

Retiro Tropical con Casa Principal, Piscina y Unidades de Alquiler que Generan Ingresos en Playa Hermosa

Descubra un oasis tropical único enclavado en las exuberantes colinas de Playa Hermosa, a solo 10 minutos de Jacó y a 1.5 horas de San José. Rodeada de una vibrante selva y abundante vida silvestre, esta finca privada ofrece un auténtico estilo de vida Pura Vida con la ventaja adicional de múltiples unidades de alquiler que generan ingresos.

La residencia principal cuenta con un espacioso diseño de concepto abierto que combina la vida interior y exterior. El amplio dormitorio principal incluye su propio baño en suite, mientras que la amplia cocina, sala de estar y comedor crean un ambiente cálido y acogedor para el entretenimiento o la relajación. Un práctico medio baño completa la casa principal.

Frente a la impresionante piscina central, un impresionante punto focal que separa las salas de estar, encontrará tres encantadoras unidades de alquiler. Dos casitas elevadas estilo casa del árbol ofrecen a los huéspedes una experiencia inmersiva en la selva, mientras que la unidad más grande de dos dormitorios incluye baño compartido, lo que la hace ideal para estancias prolongadas o para recibir visitas familiares. Todas las unidades están rodeadas de exuberantes jardines, flores tropicales y árboles maduros que atraen a monos, tucanes, guacamayas rojas y otros animales locales. Suite para el cuidador en el lugar.

Esta propiedad está perfectamente diseñada para quienes buscan tranquilidad, privacidad y conexión con la naturaleza. Ya sea como residencia privada con alojamiento para invitados o como un refugio llave en mano para generar ingresos, el entorno captura la esencia del estilo de vida costero de Costa Rica.

Una oportunidad única de poseer un auténtico refugio en una de las zonas más codiciadas del Pacífico Central. Disfrute de la tranquilidad del entorno, de la belleza natural que envuelve la propiedad y experimente el verdadero significado de Pura Vida.

properties.title: Prime Development Land in Tarcoles
properties.author: Matt Dayton

content.body:
162 Acres (65.4 Hectares) Ocean-View – Central Pacific Coast, Costa Rica

Asking Price: US $2,950,000

Location: Puntarenas Province – Tárcoles, Garabito (2-minute drive from the entrance of world-famous Carara National Park)

Property Plan Nº: P-121366-2007 | Finca Nº: 6-00147743 (clean title, registered at Registro Nacional)

Rare large ocean-view development parcel on Costa Rica’s Central Pacific coast. The property is bordered by two public roads: the Pacific Coast Highway (Ruta 34) with 77 meters of direct frontage (plus an additional 130 meters just one meter off the highway), and Calle La Barca – home to popular birdwatching lodges Cerro Lodge and Tárcoles Lodge.

Key Highlights & Existing Improvements:

– 162 pristine acres with sweeping Pacific Ocean, Tárcoles River, and Carara National Park views

– Existing master plan shows 167 lots (73 confirmed ocean-view); lots can be further subdivided to 300–400+ with updated planning

– Gravel internal road network installed 2009–2011 – roads are recoverable with minor work; property requires re-clearing of secondary growth

– TWO registered deep wells producing combined 9 L/s (5.7 + 3.3 L/s) – previously lab-tested and approved by AYA & ASADA; combined capacity sufficient for up to 400 lots

– Main water distribution line already installed along the primary internal road (not yet connected to the wells)

– 4 existing homes on the property offering immediate resale or rental potential (estimated $1.1M+ after light renovation)

– Historical sewer-treatment-plant exemption letter previously obtained (renewable)

– Previous approvals secured from CFIA, INVU, INS, Ministry of Health, and AYA – all permits and water concessions have expired and will require renewal/updating

– Only 9 minutes to the nearest beach, 20 minutes to Los Sueños Marina & Marriott, ~45 minutes to San José via Caldera Highway

– Future international airport planned in Orotina (18 km away)

Investment Upside:

Current master plan = 167 lots

With updated planning & permitting = 300–400+ lots possible

Strong potential for significant appreciation and phased development profits in one of Costa Rica’s fastest-growing coastal corridors.

This is a rare large-acreage ocean-view opportunity with substantial existing infrastructure, surrounded by Carara National Park (daily scarlet macaw flyovers), the famous Tárcoles crocodile river, and established eco-tourism.

Clean title and private tours available.

content.body:
Spacious Coastal Living Near Bejuco and Esterillos Beach

This inviting three-bedroom home in Bejuco Beach home for sale sits on an expansive two-acre property. It offers a rare combination of space, privacy, and proximity to the coast. The residence is well built and in excellent condition. It provides generous interior areas along with a garage, giving you both comfort and practicality. Because the land is so extensive, it offers room for gardens, outdoor living areas, or additional construction. The possibilities are broad while still maintaining a peaceful residential setting.

The property is located in a calm neighborhood of single-family homes, just five minutes from the beach in Esterillos. The coastal stretch between Bejuco and Esterillos is known for its long sandy shoreline, soft waves, and relaxed atmosphere. Therefore, activities like morning walks, surfing, and year-round sunsets become part of your daily rhythm. During the winter months, the area also enjoys striking ocean sunrises that add to the coastal experience.

The two-acre lot provides a sense of openness that is difficult to find so close to the beach. The home sits comfortably on the property, leaving extensive unused space that can be shaped to match your vision. Whether you want a large tropical garden, guest casitas, or expanded outdoor living, the land supports many ideas. Adding a pool is also straightforward since the terrain is flat and accessible.

While the setting feels private and spacious, the location remains convenient. You are only a short drive from Jacó, the area’s main service town, which offers supermarkets, restaurants, healthcare, and daily essentials. The coastal highway also makes regional travel simple, allowing easy access to the airport and other Central Pacific destinations.

This Bejuco Beach home for sale stands out for its land size, solid construction, and relaxed lifestyle near one of the most beloved beach areas on the Central Pacific coast.

properties.title: Modern 3-Bedroom Home with Pool in Villas Xihu, Esterillos Oeste House 31A
properties.author: Mauricio Umana

content.body:
Located in the secure gated community of Villas Xihu, this elegant 2-bedroom, 1 office room 2.5-bathroom home offers modern comfort, privacy, and tropical living just minutes from the beach.

The main house measures approximately 130 m² (1,399 ft²), complemented by a 38 m² (409 ft²) covered terrace and a saltwater pool (4 m × 9 m / 13 ft × 29.5 ft) surrounded by lush gardens. The total lot size is 1,616 m² (17,394 ft²), fully fenced and secured with an electric perimeter fence, alarm system, and electric entrance gate with remote control.

Inside, the home features a high-end fitted kitchen (made in Spain) with quality appliances, two spacious ensuite bedrooms with walk-in closets, air conditioning with dehumidifyer function throughout, and a bright open-plan living and dining area that connects seamlessly to the outdoor terrace, from which monkeys and other wildlife can be spotted. An extra office/hobby room (3 m × 3.4 m / 10 ft × 11 ft) provides extra flexibility.

Additional highlights include a basketball/sports area with 10 x 8 m. Ethernet is distributed in the whole house, laundry room, carport, emergency generator, three 1,000 L water tanks, and outdoor shower.

Villas Xihu offers professional over night security.

This property combines European-quality finishes with the relaxed coastal lifestyle of Esterillos Oeste — a perfect home or vacation retreat.

Ubicada en la exclusiva comunidad cerrada Villas Xihu, esta elegante casa de 2 dormitorios + oficina y 2.5 baños ofrece comodidad moderna, privacidad y un estilo de vida tropical a solo minutos de la playa.

La casa principal mide aproximadamente 130 m², complementada por una terraza cubierta de 38 m² y una piscina de agua salada (4 m × 9 m) rodeada de exuberosos jardines. El lote total, de 1,616 m², está completamente cercado y cuenta con cerca perimetral eléctrica, sistema de alarma y portón eléctrico con control remoto.

En el interior, la propiedad ofrece una cocina de alta gama hecha en España con electrodomésticos de calidad, además de una luminosa sala y comedor de concepto abierto que se integran perfectamente con la terraza exterior, desde donde se pueden observar monos y otras especies de vida silvestre. Ambos dormitorios son amplios, con baño privado y walk-in closet, y toda la casa cuenta con aire acondicionado con función deshumidificadora. También incluye una habitación adicional para oficina o hobbies (3 m × 3.4 m), brindando mayor flexibilidad.

Entre los extras se encuentran una área de deportes/baloncesto de 10 × 8 m, red Ethernet distribuida en toda la casa, cuarto de lavado, cochera, generador de emergencia, tres tanques de agua de 1,000 L cada uno, y ducha exterior.

Villas Xihu ofrece seguridad profesional nocturna, garantizando tranquilidad en un entorno natural y privado.

Esta propiedad combina acabados de calidad europea con el estilo de vida relajado de Esterillos Oeste: una residencia perfecta para vivir a tiempo completo o como casa de vacaciones.

BBQ rancho for social gatherings

Unbeatable Location

This coveted spot provides privacy, prestige, and proximity to everything the Central Pacific Coast has to offer.

Discover A’Mar – New Oceanfront Living in the Heart of Jaco Beach

This pre-construction development features a 21-floor condo tower with 160 well-designed residences, perfect for both full-time living and vacation rental potential. Choose from 2 and 3-bedroom floorplans, with options facing the ocean or the mountains. Every unit includes one parking space and one secure storage bodega.
