properties.title: Highest Estate in Jaco – 2.5 Acres & 3 Separated Units
properties.author: Oren Mozafi

content.body:
Highest Estate in Jaco – 2.5 Acres & 3 Separated Units

Own the highest point in Jaco Beach — where ocean, mountain, and jungle meet.

Perched approximately 200 feet above sea level and only six minutes from both the beach and downtown Jaco, this exceptional 2.5-acre estate offers a rare blend of panoramic views, privacy, and investment potential.

Key Property Highlights

	1.	Premier Location

Situated at the very top of the Jaco hillside, this property provides unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean, surrounding mountains, and the entire town below. Enjoy breathtaking 360-degree views from sunrise over the jungle to sunset over the ocean.

	2.	Expansive 2.5-Acre Lot

The property stretches from the top of the hill all the way down to Quebrada Bonita, offering both lush jungle terrain and flatter land with direct road access. This natural topography provides a unique opportunity for future expansion or eco-friendly development.

	3.	Main Pool Lounge with Panoramic Ocean Views

At the center of the property lies the pool and ocean-view lounge, surrounded by two independent apartments. Below the deck, there is ample space to build a third large apartment with sweeping mountain views—perfect for additional rental income or guest accommodations.

	4.	Separate Two-Bedroom House

On the side of the estate, a completely independent two-bedroom home features its own parking area, private access, and a fully equipped kitchen. Ideal for extended family, guests, or as a rental unit.

	5.	Development and Investment Potential

With its unmatched elevation, accessibility, and land size, this property is ideal for investors seeking to develop a boutique retreat, luxury villa compound, or eco-lodge. The space and zoning flexibility allow for multiple expansion possibilities.

	6.	Convenient Access and Total Privacy

Although the estate feels worlds away, it is located just six minutes from Jaco Beach, local restaurants, shopping centers, and entertainment.

	7.	Flexible Ownership Options

The owner is willing to finance, making this a unique opportunity for investors, expats, or families looking to secure a signature hilltop property in one of Costa Rica’s most vibrant beach towns.

Ideal For

	•	Luxury villa development

	•	Boutique hotel or wellness retreat

	•	Private residence with income-generating potential

Contact Information

Experience the best views in Jaco Beach. Contact RE/MAX Costa Rica today to schedule a private tour or to learn more about financing options.

ESPANOL

Propiedad en la Cima | 1 hectárea con Vista Panorámica en Playa Jaco, Costa Rica

Sea dueño del punto más alto de Jaco Beach — donde el océano, la montaña y la selva se encuentran.

Ubicada aproximadamente a 60 metros sobre el nivel del mar y a solo seis minutos de la playa y del centro de Jaco, esta extraordinaria finca de 1.3 hectáreas combina vistas espectaculares, privacidad total y un gran potencial de inversión.

Características Principales

	1.	Ubicación Privilegiada

Situada en la cima de la colina de Jaco, esta propiedad ofrece vistas despejadas del Océano Pacífico, las montañas circundantes y todo el valle de Jaco. Disfrute de panoramas de 360 grados, desde el amanecer sobre la selva hasta el atardecer sobre el mar.

	2.	Terreno Amplio de 1.3 Hectárea

El terreno se extiende desde la parte más alta de la colina hasta el fondo de Quebrada Bonita, con zonas de selva virgen y áreas más planas con acceso directo desde la carretera. Ideal para proyectos de expansión o desarrollo eco-responsable.

	3.	Área Principal con Piscina y Vistas al Océano

En el corazón de la propiedad se encuentra la piscina y el lounge con vista panorámica, rodeados por dos apartamentos independientes. Debajo de la terraza existe espacio suficiente para construir un tercer apartamento grande con vistas impresionantes a las montañas.

	4.	Casa Independiente de Dos Dormitorios

En un costado del terreno hay una casa completamente separada, con dos dormitorios, cocina equipada, acceso privado y su propio estacionamiento. Perfecta para invitados, alquiler a largo plazo o residencia del cuidador.

	5.	Potencial de Desarrollo e Inversión

Gracias a su ubicación elevada, tamaño y accesibilidad, esta propiedad es ideal para quienes buscan desarrollar un retiro boutique, un conjunto de villas de lujo o un proyecto turístico sostenible.

	6.	Privacidad y Cercanía

A pesar de su entorno natural y tranquilo, la finca se encuentra a solo seis minutos de la playa de Jaco, restaurantes, tiendas y vida nocturna.

	7.	Financiamiento Disponible

El propietario ofrece financiamiento, lo que convierte esta oportunidad en una excelente opción tanto para inversionistas como para quienes desean vivir en un entorno natural con todas las comodidades cerca.

Ideal para

	•	Desarrollo de villas de lujo

	•	Hotel boutique o retiro de bienestar

	•	Residencia privada con potencial de renta

Contacto

Viva la experiencia única de poseer las mejores vistas de Jaco Beach.

Comuníquese con RE/MAX Costa Rica hoy mismo para agendar una visita privada o conocer más sobre las opciones de financiamiento.

properties.title: Waterfalls | Swimming Holes | Rivers | 72 Acres
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
For Sale: 72 Acre farm with Spectacular Waterfalls!

A Unique Eco-Legacy Property Investment Opportunity: Step into an extraordinary opportunity to own a developed ecotourism property in Costa Rica, centered around a Waterfall Sanctuary. This is far more than a parcel of land — it’s a living destination, already operating, with built-in appeal, experiences, and rare natural assets.

Situated in the farming community of La Gloria, Puriscal, approximately 37 miles south of San José and about 12 miles from the Central Pacific coast. A popular area for tourism near both Jaco/ Los Suenos and Quepos/ Manual Antonio.

Surrounded by lush mountainous terrain, the site encompasses rainforest corridors, mirador overlooks, two river systems, swimming holes and five large natural waterfalls that cascade through the property.

Access is excellent!  The property is just off a main road between the beach and the capital city of San Jose.  This road is in the process of being paved.  The approach includes a short secondary gravel road.  4X4 vehicle access may be needed inside the property in the wet season.

Property Highlights & Assets:

Waterfall network: Five waterfalls that traverse the terrain, offering natural swimming pools and potential for spa/wellness features.

Trails & topography: Multiple hiking loop options (moderate to scenic grade) through forested land — ideal for guided walks, meditation paths, or extension trails.

Existing infrastructure: Visitor facilities, restroom/shower/changing area, parking, paths, entry gates, and kitchen/dining gazebo (currently operating).  There are caretakers that live onsite who handle security, maintenance, receiving guests, guiding tours and preparing guest meals.

Museology & education: On-site museum exhibits and interpretive elements focused on water science, sustainability, and cultural water traditions.

Scenic views & privacy: Elevated ridgelines offering views over valleys toward the coast, solitary ambiance, and wildlife corridors.

This asset is uniquely suited for:

Ecotourism & wellness retreats: Expand lodging, spa, sound baths, forest bathing, and wellness programs built around water.

Education & research center: Host school groups, universities, workshops, or water science residencies.

Boutique resort / glamping: Add eco-cabins, treehouses, or small lodges within the property.

Event venue: Weddings, corporate retreats, wellness summits, and experiential events using waterfalls and nature as backdrop.

Conservation / carbon credits: Partner with environmental programs, possibly generating revenue via conservation incentives or carbon offset schemes.

Why This Property Stands Out

Turnkey operation: You’re not acquiring raw land — you acquire a working museum / sanctuary with visitor flow, systems, signage, and brand recognition.

Rare natural water amenities: Having multiple waterfalls and natural pools on site is a rare and valuable natural asset.  These are some of the most accessible waterfalls in the central Pacific coast.

Proximity to both San José and the Pacific: Close enough for access to infrastructure, yet sufficiently remote to preserve serenity.

Scalable & flexible: The land can absorb further development (eco-lodging, trails, wellness facilities) without losing its core identity.

Impact & legacy: Position yourself as a steward of water, nature, and education — with a project that resonates in sustainability and meaning.

Contact us to arrange a private tour.

content.body:
Welcome to Hermosa Palms, a premier beachfront community in Playa Hermosa, Costa Rica, just 5 minutes south of the vibrant beach town of Jacó.

This spacious traditional home is ideal as a vacation property, rental investment, or full-time residence. The house is built in solid concrete for durability and quality, with all cabinets, doors, closets and furniture crafted in wood, giving it a warm and elegant feel. Minisplit air conditioning units throughout ensure comfort in every room.

On the main floor, you’ll find a cozy guest bedroom with a full bath, a large living room with a built-in bar, and an open kitchen and dining area perfect for entertaining.

Upstairs features three bedrooms, including a large primary suite with ensuite bathroom, space for a walk-in closet, and a private balcony to enjoy the marine breeze.

properties.title: Oceanfront Hotel Jaco
properties.author: Timothygiannone

content.body:
This Ocenfront Hotel presents a rare and exciting opportunity to own a fully operational beachfront hotel in the heart of Jaco Beach, Costa Rica. Ideally situated just steps from the ocean and within walking distance to the lively downtown area, this property offers both lifestyle appeal and solid investment potential in one of the most visited destinations along the Central Pacific coast.

This established hotel is comprised of eighteen rentable units, designed to accommodate a variety of guest preferences. Twelve of the rooms are well-appointed standard suites that offer air conditioning, private bathrooms, and views of the pool and lush gardens. Four additional units are larger suites, ideal for families or longer-term travelers seeking more space and comfort. At the top of the property are two penthouse-style units, each featuring a kitchenette and private balcony—making them well-suited for luxury guests or as owner-occupied residences.

At the center of the hotel grounds is a fully functioning restaurant and bar. It serves both guests and locals, with an inviting atmosphere and outdoor terrace that opens up to the pool area. This commercial kitchen and dining space could easily be expanded or rebranded into a signature dining experience or a lively social hub catering to tourists and residents alike.

What truly sets South Beach Hotel apart is its exceptional location. Positioned across the street from the beach and on one of Jaco’s main commercial avenues, it benefits from a constant flow of foot and vehicle traffic. The street frontage offers significant commercial value and could be transformed into additional income streams through the addition of retail space, a surf shop, spa, or café. With high visibility and accessibility, the property is ideally suited for creative development or simply continued operation as a thriving boutique hotel.

Whether you are looking to add a boutique hotel to your investment portfolio, enter the Costa Rican hospitality market, or capitalize on Jaco’s strong year-round tourism demand, South Beach Hotel offers a turnkey opportunity with outstanding potential. Its flexible layout, prime location, and commercial exposure make it one of the most compelling offerings currently available in the Central Pacific.

El South Beach Hotel presenta una oportunidad única y emocionante para adquirir un hotel frente al mar, totalmente operativo, en el corazón de Playa Jacó, Costa Rica. Idealmente ubicado a solo pasos del océano y a una corta distancia a pie del animado centro de la ciudad, esta propiedad combina un atractivo estilo de vida con un sólido potencial de inversión en uno de los destinos más visitados de la costa del Pacífico Central.

Este hotel consolidado cuenta con dieciocho unidades en alquiler, diseñadas para adaptarse a una variedad de preferencias de huéspedes. Doce de las habitaciones son cómodas suites estándar que ofrecen aire acondicionado, baños privados y vistas a la piscina y a los exuberantes jardines. Cuatro unidades adicionales son suites más amplias, ideales para familias o viajeros de estadías prolongadas que buscan mayor espacio y confort. En la parte superior de la propiedad se encuentran dos unidades tipo penthouse, cada una con kitchenette y balcón privado, perfectas para huéspedes de lujo o como residencias para propietarios.

En el centro del hotel se ubica un restaurante y bar totalmente operativos. Atiende tanto a huéspedes como a locales, con un ambiente acogedor y una terraza al aire libre que se abre hacia la zona de la piscina. Esta cocina comercial y espacio de comedor podrían ampliarse o reimaginarse fácilmente en una experiencia gastronómica distintiva o en un animado punto social para turistas y residentes por igual.

Lo que realmente distingue al South Beach Hotel es su ubicación excepcional. Situado frente a la playa y sobre una de las principales avenidas comerciales de Jacó, se beneficia de un constante flujo de tráfico peatonal y vehicular. El frente de calle ofrece un valor comercial significativo y podría transformarse en fuentes adicionales de ingresos mediante la incorporación de locales comerciales, una tienda de surf, un spa o un café. Con alta visibilidad y accesibilidad, la propiedad es ideal tanto para un desarrollo creativo como para continuar operando exitosamente como un hotel boutique.

Ya sea que desee agregar un hotel boutique a su portafolio de inversiones, ingresar al mercado de hospitalidad en Costa Rica o capitalizar la fuerte demanda turística durante todo el año en Jacó, el South Beach Hotel ofrece una oportunidad llave en mano con un potencial sobresaliente. Su diseño flexible, ubicación privilegiada y exposición comercial lo convierten en una de las ofertas más atractivas actualmente disponibles en el Pacífico Central.

Le South Beach Hotel représente une opportunité rare et exceptionnelle d’acquérir un hôtel en bord de mer, entièrement opérationnel, au cœur de Playa Jacó, Costa Rica. Idéalement situé à seulement quelques pas de l’océan et à distance de marche du centre animé, cet établissement combine à la fois un style de vie attrayant et un solide potentiel d’investissement dans l’une des destinations les plus prisées de la côte Pacifique centrale.

Cet hôtel bien établi comprend dix-huit unités locatives, conçues pour répondre à une variété de préférences de la clientèle. Douze chambres sont des suites standards bien aménagées, équipées de la climatisation, de salles de bain privées et offrant des vues sur la piscine et les jardins tropicaux. Quatre unités supplémentaires sont des suites plus spacieuses, idéales pour les familles ou les voyageurs de longue durée à la recherche de confort et d’espace. Enfin, deux unités de style penthouse, chacune avec kitchenette et balcon privé, se trouvent au sommet de la propriété, parfaites pour les clients haut de gamme ou comme résidences pour les propriétaires.

Au centre de l’hôtel se trouve un restaurant-bar entièrement fonctionnel. Il accueille aussi bien les clients que les habitants, dans une atmosphère conviviale avec une terrasse extérieure ouverte sur la piscine. Cet espace de restauration et sa cuisine professionnelle pourraient facilement être agrandis ou transformés en un concept gastronomique unique, ou encore devenir un lieu de rencontre animé pour touristes et résidents.

Ce qui distingue véritablement le South Beach Hotel, c’est son emplacement exceptionnel. Situé juste en face de la plage et le long de l’une des principales avenues commerciales de Jacó, il bénéficie d’un flux constant de piétons et de véhicules. Sa façade sur rue offre une valeur commerciale considérable et pourrait générer de nouvelles sources de revenus grâce à l’ajout de commerces, d’une boutique de surf, d’un spa ou d’un café. Avec sa visibilité et son accessibilité remarquables, la propriété est idéale pour un développement créatif ou pour continuer à prospérer en tant qu’hôtel boutique.

Que vous souhaitiez ajouter un hôtel boutique à votre portefeuille d’investissements, entrer sur le marché hôtelier costaricien ou tirer parti de la forte demande touristique de Jacó tout au long de l’année, le South Beach Hotel offre une opportunité clé en main au potentiel exceptionnel. Son agencement flexible, son emplacement de premier choix et son exposition commerciale en font l’une des offres les plus attractives actuellement disponibles sur le Pacifique central.

properties.title: Ocean View Esterillos Oeste | Walk to Beach
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
This ocean view apartment is a short walk to the beautiful beach of Esterillos Oeste. Known for great surfing for all skill levels and world class fishing. This sleepy Costa Rica village has tidal pools filled with tropical fish and wild life galore. The water is always warm and there are safe swimming areas sheltered from the waves on low tide. The world famous La Sirena mermaid statue is just steps away from your front door.

The current owners have painstakingly remodeled this unit with a brand new kitchen, cabinets, granite countertops and top of the line appliances throughout. There is custom solid wood furniture including a hand carved kingside bed and side tables in the ocean view master suite and a one of a kind bunkbed that has a king below with a queen on top!

Ocean views are seen from anywhere inside. There are new sheer blinds and black out blinds throughout, revealing the phenomenal view of the coastline, surfing, humpback whales and scarlet macaws that fly by daily.

Cool off in the infinity edge pool with a swim up bar or walk two blocks to the Pacific ocean for a snorkel or surf. This building known as “Surf watchers” has just three levels, each owned by separate shares of the corporation that holds this property. Each level is separately metered for electricity and each owner maintains their own unit inside, air conditioners and railings, while expenses like pool cleaning, the exterior and corporation maintenance are shared three ways, making this unit exceptionally affordable to own.

There is a huge reserve water tank for the building with a pump to ensure that water and pressure are available on demand anytime. There is a separate enclosed laundry room with a new washer and dryer and even a back up refrigerator. All kitchenware, houseware, towels and linens are also included, so you only need to bring your clothes and toothbrush.

There is too much more to list, so come and tour this unique opportunity to own a place in paradise where you will be in awe everyday and proud to share with your family and friends.

This makes it an ideal location for both residential and commercial development, attracting local and international visitors who seek easy access to Costa Rica’s premier destinations while enjoying the tranquility of Esterillos.

The 65 hectares of land are rich with biodiversity, providing a natural haven for wildlife and vegetation, making it a perfect option for eco-tourism projects, residential communities, or a sustainable retreat. A private road divides the property, offering seamless access to a nearby Natural Reservation, only 5 minutes away, and ensuring privacy for future developments.

In addition to its scenic landscape, the property includes two profitable palm tree oil plantations, offering immediate agricultural revenue while expanding its financial potential. The terrain is fully leveled, with all soil preparation completed, making it construction-ready for residential or commercial purposes.

Whether you envision a luxury resort, gated community, eco-lodge, or mixed-use development, the location and diverse investment opportunities of this lot are unmatched. המגרש ממוקם בצורה אסטרטגית, רק 20 דקות מג’אקו – עיירת חוף תוססת הידועה בתיירותה השוקקת, ורק 45 דקות מפארק מנואל אנטוניו – פארק לאומי מפורסם ויעד תיירותי עולמי. מיקום זה הופך אותו לאידיאלי לפיתוח מגורים או מסחר, ומשפיע על משיכת מבקרים מקומיים ובינלאומיים המחפשים גישה נוחה ליעדים המובילים בקוסטה ריקה תוך כדי הנאה מהשלווה של אסטריוס.

הקרקע בשטח 65 הקטרים עשירה במגוון ביולוגי, מה שמספק מקלט טבעי עבור חיות בר וצמחייה, ומהווה אופציה מושלמת למיזמי אקוטוריזם, קהילות מגורים או ריטריט בר קיימא. דרך פרטית מחלקת את הנכס, ומספקת גישה חלקה לשמורת טבע סמוכה, רק 5 דקות משם, ומבטיחה פרטיות עבור הפיתוחים העתידיים.

בנוסף לנוף המרהיב, הנכס כולל שני מטעי דקל מניבים ורווחיים, שמספקים הכנסה חקלאית מיידית תוך הרחבת הפוטנציאל הכלכלי. השטח מישורי לחלוטין, עם הכנת קרקע מלאה, מה שמאפשר בנייה מיידית עבור מגורים או שימוש מסחרי.

בין אם אתם מדמיינים ריזורט יוקרתי, קהילת מגורים סגורה, אקו-לודג’ או פיתוח מעורב, מיקום זה והאפשרויות ההשקעה המגוונות של המגרש הזה הם ללא תחרות. יתרה מכך, הנכס נמצא רק 7 דקות ממעגל היציאה מכביש קוסטנרה, מה שמספק חיבור מצוין לתושבים ולתיירים כאחד.

המוכר מוכן לממן חצי ממחיר הנכס לאורך מספר שנים, עם ריבית שניתנת למשא ומתן.

מגרש זה בשטח 65 הקטרים באסטריוס מציע הזדמנות חד-פעמית ליצור פיתוח ייחודי שמשתלב בהרמוניה עם הטבע הסובב, תוך ניצול המיקום האסטרטגי וערוצי ההכנסה החקלאיים הקיימים.

properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Casa Cortez is the perfect home in paradise for entertaining or just enjoying the tropical climate of Costa Rica!  Built on a thoughtfully landscaped half acre lot (2319 meters) filled with mature tropical plants, fruit trees and coconut palms this home features a huge swimming pool with cascading waterfall, multiple ranchos, one elevated over the garage and overlooking the pool and another with and outdoor kitchen featuring a brick pizza oven and full bathroom!  There is also a shaded palapa seating area on the far side of the pool for those that want to kick back in the shade and enjoy a pina colada or smoothie.

To access the land, drive through the remote controlled arched gateway and up the paverstone drive to reach the home and garage.  The home features a wrap around kitchen with solid wood cabinetry a bar.  In fact, there is solid wood throughout the home in all cabnets, doors and closets! There is a separate dining area, living room and laundry room and all of the furniture and appliances are included with the home!

Downstairs there are two bedrooms with a “Jack and Jill” style bathroom with the master suite up top with a beautiful panorama view of the property and a private bathroom.  All indoor spaces are airconditioned.

This home has everything you can hope for in a vacation home or full time residence, or is perfect for a vacation rental property with ample parking and made for fun!  It is priced aggressively for a quick sale, so dont hesitate to schedule your tour today!

The fenced perimeter adds clarity to the lot boundaries and supports straightforward planning.

Jacó continues to grow as a coastal community with a strong mix of tourism, long-term residents, and local businesses. Because of this growth, development sites close to the beach remain in high demand. The property’s proximity to the town center and the coastline creates a reliable foundation for many types of ideas. Whether the next owner chooses to create residential units, adapt the existing houses, or design a mixed-use layout, the setting supports a variety of outcomes.

This Jaco development property offers a rare combination of location, size, and adaptability. Its corner position, walkable surroundings, and flexible structures create a practical starting point for anyone interested in shaping a new project in an accessible and active coastal area. With its strong visibility and convenient placement, the site provides a solid base for thoughtful development in one of Jacó’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Luxurious 10th floor beachfront condo. Experience coastal living in this stunning 10th-floor beachfront condo, located in the serene north end of Jaco Beach. This exclusive, private, and gated residence offers unparalleled access to the sand and ocean of the Pacific, making it the perfect getaway or rental property.

 Condo features:

•	2 Spacious Bedrooms

•	2 Full Bathrooms

•	Expansive Terrace with Stunning Sunset, River, and Mountain Views

•      Beachfront Pool and Direct Beach Access

•	Private and Gated Community

•	Fully Equipped Kitchen

Step into this elegantly designed condo and be greeted by an open-concept living space that seamlessly blends comfort and style. The fully equipped kitchen features modern appliances and ample counter space, perfect for preparing meals to enjoy in the dining area or on the spacious terrace, where the breathtaking views of the sunset over the ocean, river, and mountains create an idyllic backdrop.

The master suite offers a tranquil retreat with its own en-suite bathroom, while the second bedroom provides comfort and privacy for family or guests. Both bathrooms are beautifully appointed with high-end fixtures and finishes.

Outside, the beachfront pool invites you to take a refreshing dip or simply relax by the water. With direct access to the beach, you can enjoy morning walks on the sand, afternoon swims, and evening sunsets right at your doorstep.

Located just 90 minutes from the airport, Jaco Beach is an active town bursting with energy and charm. Discover a vibrant community with an array of restaurants, cafes, and souvenir shops. Enjoy thrilling outdoor activities, from world-class surfing to guided tours exploring the rich natural beauty of Costa Rica. Jaco’s lively atmosphere and convenient location make it a top destination for both relaxation and adventure.

This condo is not just a home, but a gateway to the vibrant culture, eclectic dining, and exciting activities that Jaco has to offer. Its prime location and luxurious amenities make it an excellent investment opportunity, ideal for rentals or as your own private paradise.

Don’t miss the chance to own this extraordinary beachfront condo in Jaco, Costa Rica. Contact us today to schedule a private tour and discover the lifestyle you’ve always dreamed of.

Esta exclusiva residencia privada y cerrada ofrece un acceso incomparable a la arena y al mar del Pacífico, lo que la convierte en el refugio perfecto o una excelente propiedad de alquiler.

Características del condominio:

•	2 Amplios Dormitorios

•	2 Baños Completos

•	Amplia Terraza con Impresionantes Vistas al Atardecer, al Río y a las Montañas

•	Piscina Frente al Mar y Acceso Directo a la Playa

•	Comunidad Privada y Cerrada

•	Cocina Totalmente Equipada

Entre en este elegante condominio y sea recibido por un espacio de vida de concepto abierto que combina a la perfección comodidad y estilo. La cocina totalmente equipada cuenta con electrodomésticos modernos y una amplia superficie de trabajo, perfecta para preparar comidas y disfrutar en el comedor o en la espaciosa terraza, donde las impresionantes vistas del atardecer sobre el océano, el río y las montañas crean un fondo idílico.

La suite principal ofrece un refugio tranquilo con su propio baño privado, mientras que el segundo dormitorio proporciona comodidad y privacidad para la familia o los invitados. Ambos baños están bellamente equipados con accesorios y acabados de alta gama.

En el exterior, la piscina frente al mar le invita a darse un refrescante chapuzón o simplemente relajarse junto al agua. Con acceso directo a la playa, puede disfrutar de paseos matutinos por la arena, nadar por la tarde y atardeceres al final del día, todo justo en su puerta.

Ubicado a solo 90 minutos del aeropuerto, Playa Jacó es un pueblo activo lleno de energía y encanto. Descubra una comunidad vibrante con una variedad de restaurantes, cafés y tiendas de souvenirs. Disfrute de emocionantes actividades al aire libre, desde surf de clase mundial hasta tours guiados que exploran la rica belleza natural de Costa Rica. La animada atmósfera de Jaco y su ubicación conveniente lo convierten en un destino ideal tanto para la relajación como para la aventura.

Este condominio no es solo un hogar, sino una puerta de entrada a la vibrante cultura, la ecléctica gastronomía y las emocionantes actividades que Jaco tiene para ofrecer. Su ubicación privilegiada y sus lujosas comodidades lo convierten en una excelente oportunidad de inversión, ideal para alquileres o como su propio paraíso privado.

No pierda la oportunidad de poseer este extraordinario condominio frente al mar en Jaco, Costa Rica. Contáctenos hoy para programar una visita privada y descubrir el estilo de vida con el que siempre ha soñado.

properties.title: Professionally Planted and Managed Hardwood Plantation | One of Four | Bird 98
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Brinkman y Asociados Reforestadores de Centro America S.A. (BARCA) has carefully tended BIRD forests that have helped bring back displaced birds and animals, along with good local jobs. The wood produced as a result is ethical and sustainable, providing our investors with solid returns. Using techniques first developed more than 40 years ago in the forests of British Columbia, everything the BARCA team does is designed to maximize the long-term health of the ecosystem under their care. From site preparation to seed selection to the correct timing of pruning, our technicians coax each tree to its full potential. Harvesting is undertaken responsibly, to ensure a steady supply for decades to come.

This is a showcase project cited by the FAO-MINAE, 2016 as an example of sustainable forest restoration projects and is a combination of native forest protection, native species plantations, and high-quality teak, creating a unique eco-plantation that creates habitat at the same time as financial returns. A unique set of adjacent farms comprised of 339 ha of pristine land of which 178 ha were planted with about 90 ha in teak and around 88 ha in native hardwood species.

As of 2023, these farms have a standing inventory of planted native species whose age classes range between 23 and 28 years which an investor can generate a return from a timber harvest beginning immediately. Between 2015 and 2023, all of the 90 ha of teak were harvested and 28 ha of teak were replanted with the latest generation of high-performance clonal teak stock. This new teak planted in 2015 is growing above average and being managed very professionally and under FSC® (NC-FM/COC- 00152) certification standards.

The 88 ha of native species hardwood stands, currently between 23 and 28 years old, will provide midterm cash flow until the other younger stocks are ready. In addition, there is the opportunity to integrate cacao (chocolate) plantations into both the teak and native forest stands, configuring the stands to create optimal shade cover for the cacao. Cacao could provide a revenue stream beginning in 3 to 4 years of being planted.

The farms contain 149 ha of natural forest that have been protected by BARCA and provide an environmental anchor with the possibility of attaining future compensation under the Payment for Ecosystem Services – “Pago de Servicios Ambientales” – of the FONAFIFO-MINAE program. These natural forests represent important corridors for the flora and fauna of the region. The BIRD farms are FSC® certified with certification Code: NC-FM/COC-000152.3.

The farms are located on the central pacific coast Costa Rica and have spectacular views of the coastline and surrounding mountains with the potential for future development.

Nestled in the serene mountains of Bijagual, this beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. Surrounded by lush greenery and panoramic mountain views, this property provides a peaceful retreat while still being just a short drive from the vibrant beach town of Jaco.

Key Features:

•	Spacious Living Areas: The open-concept living and dining spaces are filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for both relaxation and entertaining.

• Fully Equipped Kitchen: Enjoy preparing meals in the modern kitchen, with appliances, plenty of counter space, and ample storage.

• Master Suite: The large master bedroom boasts the tranquil sound of the nearby creek, an en-suite bathroom, and wardrobe closet, providing a private sanctuary.

•	Two Additional Bedrooms: The additional two bedrooms are generously sized and share a well-appointed second bathroom, making this home ideal for families or guests.

•	Outdoor Pool: Step outside to your own private oasis—a sparkling outdoor pool surrounded by lush landscaping, ideal for swimming, sunbathing, or hosting gatherings in the cool mountain air.

•	Breathtaking Views: The expansive outdoor space allows you to enjoy sweeping views of the mountains and jungle, with plenty of room for outdoor dining or simply relaxing with nature.

•	Peaceful Location: Located in the tranquil mountain community of Bijagual, this home offers a unique opportunity to enjoy both the beauty of the countryside and proximity to Jaco’s beaches, dining, and amenities.

Impresionante Casa de 3 Habitaciones y 2 Baños en las Montañas de Bijagual con Piscina Exterior Privada

Ubicada en las serenas montañas de Bijagual, esta hermosa casa de 3 habitaciones y 2 baños ofrece el escape perfecto del ajetreo y bullicio de la vida urbana. Rodeada de una exuberante vegetación y vistas panorámicas a las montañas, esta propiedad ofrece un refugio tranquilo, a solo un corto trayecto en coche de la vibrante ciudad costera de Jaco.

Características Clave:

•	Amplias Áreas Comunes: Los espacios abiertos de sala y comedor están llenos de luz natural, creando una atmósfera cálida y acogedora, ideal para relajarse o recibir invitados.

•	Cocina Totalmente Equipada: Disfrute de la cocina moderna, amplio espacio en el mostrador y abundante almacenamiento.

•	Dos Habitaciones Adicionales: Las otras dos habitaciones son de buen tamaño y comparten un segundo baño bien equipado, lo que hace que esta casa sea ideal para familias o visitas.

•	Ubicación Tranquila: Situada en la tranquila comunidad montañosa de Bijagual, esta casa ofrece la oportunidad única de disfrutar tanto de la belleza del campo como de la cercanía a las playas, restaurantes y servicios de Jaco.

Nestled in the scenic landscapes of Bijagual, Costa Rica, this 21-hectare farm awaits for an ecotourism project. The abundant water sources, fertile soils, and nature in every meter make this farm the perfect land for eco-friendly living . Bijagual’s unique environment, rich in biodiversity, presents a perfect setting for self-sustaining, eco-friendly developments.

Bijagual is a hub for ecotourism, driven by its lush rainforests, wildlife, and close proximity to popular tourist destinations like Jaco Beach and Manuel Antonio National Park. Ecotourism ventures often prioritize sustainability, which aligns with Costa Rica’s national goal of becoming carbon-neutral. Investors looking at Bijagual for real estate should consider eco-friendly lodgings, guided nature tours, and organic farming experiences amomg others.

Sustainability is not just a buzzword; it’s a necessity in modern real estate development. In Bijagual, you can integrate eco-friendly design with renewable energy and water conservation to create self-sustaining properties. These facilities use solar panels, rainwater harvesting, and natural waste treatment to reduce their reliance on external resources.

Ubicada en los bellos paisajes de Bijagual, Costa Rica, esta finca de 21 hectáreas espera un proyecto de ecoturismo. Las abundantes fuentes de agua, los suelos fértiles y la naturaleza en cada metro hacen de esta la propiedad perfecta para una vida ecológica. El entorno único de Bijagual, rico en biodiversidad, presenta un escenario perfecto para desarrollos autosostenibles de la mano con el medio ambiente.

Bijagual es un centro para el ecoturismo, impulsado por sus exuberantes selvas tropicales, vida silvestre y proximidad a destinos turísticos populares como Playa Jacó y el Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio.

Los emprendimientos de ecoturismo a menudo priorizan la sostenibilidad, lo que se alinea con el objetivo nacional de Costa Rica de convertirse en carbono neutral. Los inversores que buscan bienes raíces en Bijagual deben considerar alojamientos ecológicos, tours guiados y experiencias de agricultura orgánica entre otros.

La sostenibilidad no es solo una palabra de moda; Es una necesidad en el desarrollo inmobiliario moderno. En Bijagual, puede integrar el diseño ecológico con energía renovable y conservación de agua para crear propiedades autosostenibles. Estas instalaciones utilizan paneles solares, recolección de agua de lluvia y tratamiento natural de desechos para reducir su dependencia de recursos externos.

Discover a hidden paradise in Playa Hermosa, within the exclusive community of Río Encantado. These rivers feature several waterfalls and natural pools, perfect for enjoying a refreshing swim in the midst of nature.

Imagine building your home or a retreat center surrounded by this lush nature, where every corner exudes a unique and revitalizing energy. This is more than just a property; it is a sanctuary where nature and serenity come together to offer an unparalleled lifestyle.

Don’t miss the opportunity to live in this unique place! Contact us for more information and visit this natural refuge that will take your breath away.

properties.title: Affordable Up Country Living | Private and Peaceful | Home in the Hills
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Ready to relax in the real Costa Rica?  This super affordable home is perfect for either a peaceful life in the rural hill country of Costa Rica, or a weekend getaway cottage.  Located just an hour drive from the beaches and tourist areas of Manuel Antonio and Jaco beach, this home is also near a daily bus route to the capital city of San Jose.

I personally own property in this area and plan to build a weekend cottage for my family.  This neighborhood is like going back in time.  It is not unusual to see local farmers herding cattle down the roads or a traditional Costa Rica Ox Cart carrying the days harvest to the market.  You are surrounded by lush natural vegetation and frequented by Toucans, parrots and a huge variety of colorful birds.  When you hear “Pura Vida”, this is what they mean!

The house is simple and rustic.  Drinkable water is provided by the asada from a local spring.  The home has numerous fruit bearing trees in the nice sized yard.  There’s an open aired kitchen, which stays cool all day.  There is a carport to keep your vehicle shaded and out of the rain.  Two bedrooms incase you have an overnight guest.  There is a storage bodega/laundry area and a small patio used for outdoor grilling.

The home has electric provided by ICE and there is a wireless internet signal from ICE Kolbi as well as Starlink satellite service available in Costa Rica now as well!  If you are looking for an affordable home in the hills in paradise, schedule a tour today!

properties.title: Exotic hardwood farms | Teak plantation | Land bank opportunity
properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Brinkman y Asociados Reforestadores de Centro America S.A. (BARCA) has carefully tended BIRD forests that have helped bring back displaced birds and animals, along with good local jobs. The wood produced as a result is ethical and sustainable, providing our investors with solid returns.  Using techniques first developed more than 40 years ago in the forests of British Columbia, everything the BARCA team does is designed to maximize the long-term health of the ecosystem under their care. From site preparation to seed selection to the correct timing of pruning, our technicians coax each tree to its full potential. Harvesting is undertaken responsibly, to ensure a steady supply for decades to come.

This is a showcase project cited by the FAO-MINAE, 2016 as an example of sustainable forest restoration projects and is a combination of native forest protection, native species plantations, and high-quality teak, creating a unique eco-plantation that creates habitat at the same time as financial returns. A unique set of adjacent farms comprised of 339 ha of pristine land of which 178 ha were planted with about 90 ha in teak and around 88 ha in native hardwood species.

As of 2023, these farms have a standing inventory of planted native species whose age classes range between 23 and 28 years which an investor can generate a return from a timber harvest beginning immediately. Between 2015 and 2023, all of the 90 ha of teak were harvested and 28 ha of teak were replanted with the latest generation of high-performance clonal teak stock. This new teak planted in 2015 is growing above average and being managed very professionally and under FSC® (NC-FM/COC- 00152) certification standards.

The 88 ha of native species hardwood stands, currently between 23 and 28 years old, will provide midterm cash flow until the other younger stocks are ready. In addition, there is the opportunity to integrate cacao  (chocolate) plantations into both the teak and native forest stands, configuring the stands to create optimal shade cover for the cacao. Cacao could provide a revenue stream beginning in 3 to 4 years of being planted.

The farms contain 149 ha of natural forest that have been protected by BARCA and provide an environmental anchor with the possibility of attaining future compensation under the Payment for Ecosystem Services – “Pago de Servicios Ambientales” – of the FONAFIFO-MINAE program. These natural forests represent important corridors for the flora and fauna of the region. The BIRD farms are FSC® certified with certification Code: NC-FM/COC-000152.3.

The farms are located on the central pacific coast Costa Rica and have spectacular views of the coastline and surrounding mountains with the potential for future development.

Location and Orientation

Position: The lot is perched on an elevated coastal area, offering unobstructed panoramic views of the ocean. — Orientation: It faces west, ensuring breathtaking sunsets over the water, with sunlight gracing the property throughout the day.

Access and Utilities

Surroundings and Views

Views: The primary feature is the sweeping ocean view, with the horizon stretching as far as the eye can see. Depending on the exact location, you might also enjoy views of nearby coastal cliffs, beaches, and perhaps even a glimpse of marine wildlife.

Architectural Potential

Design: The size and shape of the lot offer incredible flexibility for architectural creativity. Consider designs that maximize the views, such as floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive decks, and outdoor living spaces.

In summary, this 5,885 square meter ocean view lot is a rare gem, offering endless possibilities for creating a private paradise. Its combination of size, location, and natural beauty makes it an ideal canvas for your coastal dream home.

content.body:
GREAT DEAL!!!

This renovated 2 bedroom condo offers beautiful finishes.

2 comfortable bedroom and one full bathroom, a/c, fully equipped kitchen.

Fully equipped haven, designed for immediate enjoyment and optimal flexibility with short-term Airbnb rentals.

 Villas Paradise Condominiums is located on the main street of Jaco Beach in Costa Rica. These Jaco Beach Condos for sale and for rent are among the local favorites with low Home Owners Association fees and great rental potential. Although the community has 154 condos, the neighborhood is peaceful. All the condominiums at Villas Paradise have one level. There is a great mix of neighbors from all over the world in the Villas Paradise community but mostly they are comprised of American, Canadians and Costa Ricans.

The large community pool, Jacuzzi and gardens are well maintained. Villas Paradise has 24 hour security and there is ample parking. The Villas Paradise community is extremely safe and secure and the monthly maintenance fees are low.

Villas Paradise is located a short one block walk to the beach. Because of the location and affordability, the Villas Paradise condominiums make for great rental properties. If you are interested feel free to contact our agents at the REMAX Oceanside real estate office.

Jaco Beach

The coastal city of Jaco Beach is located on the Pacific Region of Costa Rica. This area is the perfect combination of a laid back local community and touristic attractions. The area has become a tourist mecca in Costa Rica. The lifestyle and standard of living makes this town very appealing for both retirees and locals.

The city of Jaco Beach is an international hub with a population of approximately 20,000. The town is a short drive from the international airport, approximately an hour and a half, which makes it one of the most visited beach towns in Costa Rica. The atmosphere is very relaxed and the locals are warm an friendly. The beach of Jaco is 2.5 miles long and offers world famous surf. Catching waves is one of the most popular activities in the city. Besides the surf Jaco offers a wide range of outdoor activities like ATV tours, deep sea fishing, hiking, biking, horseback riding, canopy tours, yoga classes and incredible national parks.

Among the many amenities in Jaco you find several retail options. You are conveniently near of large supermarkets and smaller convenience stores, medical services, spas, shops, banks, and a movie theater. There are incredible restaurants to find in Jaco fir every taste and budget. the tow is also known for its vibrant nightlife. There are plenty of bars, casinos and nightclubs.

Welcome to your dream home in the heart of paradise! Nestled within a gated community, this newly built, fully furnished residence offers the epitome of beach living with a perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

Step into this magnificent three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom home. As you enter, you’ll be greeted by an inviting living space adorned with contemporary furnishings and tasteful decor, providing a seamless transition from indoor to outdoor living where you can enjoy at the beautiful terrace.

The main level boasts an open-concept layout, featuring a spacious living room, dining area, and a modern kitchen.

Conveniently designed with a first-floor bedroom with ensuite bathroom for added convenience and privacy. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional generously sized bedrooms, each appointed with its own ensuite bathroom, offering ample space and comfort for all.

The community offers a recently renovated pool and rancho where you can soak up the sun and relax with friends and family.

Located just 1.5 kilometers away from the surfing world-renowned Hermosa Beach, this exceptional property offers easy access to outdoor adventures, from surfing, hiking, mountain biking to sunset strolls along the shoreline.

With easy access to all the amenities Jaco has to offer, from grocery stores and pharmacies to banks and medical facilities, you’ll have everything you need right at your fingertips. Whether you’re craving a relaxing day at the beach or an exhilarating night on the town, this prime location ensures that every convenience and pleasure is within reach.

Don’t miss your chance to experience the best of Costa Rica’s Pura Vida lifestyle – schedule a private visit today and make this stunning property your own!

Bienvenido a tu hogar de ensueño en el corazón del paraíso! Ubicada en una comunidad cerrada, esta residencia recién construida y completamente amueblada ofrece el epítome de la vida de playa con una perfecta combinación de comodidad y conveniencia.

Al entrar a esta magnífica casa de tres dormitorios y tres baños y medio, serás recibido por un espacio de vida acogedor decorada con buen gusto y con muebles contemporáneos, proporcionando una transición perfecta de la vida interior a la exterior donde puedes disfrutar en la hermosa terraza.

El primer nivel cuenta con un diseño de concepto abierto, que incluye una amplia sala, comedor y una cocina moderna.

 Diseñado convenientemente con un dormitorio en el primer piso con baño privado para mayor comodidad y privacidad. Arriba, encontrarás dos dormitorios adicionales de generosas dimensiones, cada uno equipado con su propio baño, ofreciendo un amplio espacio y comodidad para todos.

La comunidad ofrece una piscina y rancho recientemente renovados donde puedes tomar el sol y relajarte con amigos y familiares.

Ubicada a solo 1.5 kilómetros de la mundialmente conocida Playa Hermosa, famosa por el surf, esta propiedad excepcional ofrece fácil acceso a aventuras al aire libre, desde surf, senderismo, ciclismo de montaña hasta paseos al atardecer a lo largo de la costa.

Con fácil acceso a todas las comodidades que Jacó tiene para ofrecer, desde supermercados y farmacias hasta bancos y centros médicos, tendrás todo lo que necesitas al alcance de tu mano. Ya sea que anheles un día relajante en la playa o una noche emocionante en la ciudad, esta ubicación privilegiada garantiza que cada conveniencia y placer esté al alcance de la mano.

No pierdas la oportunidad de experimentar lo mejor del estilo de vida Pura Vida de Costa Rica: ¡agenda tu visitahoy mismo y haz de esta impresionante propiedad tu propia casa!

content.body:
Prime Mixed-Use Lot in the Heart of Jaco Beach

This Jaco Beach residential commercial lot offers a rare opportunity to secure a versatile property in one of the town’s most strategic locations. Positioned just steps from both the lively city center and the scenic shoreline. This 1,257 m² lot delivers an ideal setting for mixed-use development while maintaining the tranquility of a coastal lifestyle. With water and electricity already available, the lot provides a ready foundation for a project tailored to your vision.

The setting blends convenience and serenity. Palm trees sway along nearby streets. A calm location, yet downtown Jaco remains only moments away. You can walk to cafés, boutiques, restaurants, and essential services, giving this property exceptional appeal for commercial concepts, residential builds, or a combination of both. Because the land is flat and accessible, you have the freedom to shape it according to your design goals.

Walkable Location Surrounded by Coastal Lifestyle

The property’s location enhances its versatility. Entrepreneurs can take advantage of Jaco’s steady foot traffic and vibrant tourism scene, making this corner lot a strong option for storefronts, offices, hospitality concepts, or creative multi-use ideas. Those seeking a residential retreat will appreciate the ability to build a home within walking distance of the beach, where morning strolls, warm sunsets, and ocean breezes become part of daily life.

This balance of city energy and coastal calm is what makes the area so desirable. Jaco continues to grow as the central hub of the Pacific Coast, offering excellent dining, outdoor activities, and easy access to San José and the international airport. With its prime placement, utility access, and flexible zoning potential, the property stands out as a compelling opportunity.

If you would like more details or wish to schedule a visit, feel free to contact me today.

Enjoy sweeping 180-degree views of the surf and sandy beach from the beautiful porch, surrounded by open green spaces and a relaxing jacuzzi—perfect for taking in the stunning coastal sunsets.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a stylish living area and a modern kitchen. The two generously sized bedrooms feature independent air conditioning units for personalized comfort and share a well-appointed bathroom. Nestled within the lush landscapes of Costa Rica, this expansive building lot spans over 4000 square meters, offering a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create your dream home in a truly idyllic setting. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain views, this property is a canvas for your imagination, ready to be transformed into a private haven that seamlessly blends with nature’s beauty.

The awe-inspiring panorama of the surrounding mountains is a constant reminder of the untouched natural splendor that envelops this unique property. Imagine waking up to the sight of the sun rising over the verdant peaks and ending your day with the serene colors of a Costa Rican sunset. This is the daily gift that this building lot offers, making it a perfect retreat for nature enthusiasts and those seeking tranquility.

Hiking trails crisscross the area, inviting you to explore the dense tropical forests, discover hidden waterfalls, and marvel at the diverse flora and fauna. Costa Rica’s incredible wildlife is at your doorstep, with the possibility of spotting exotic creatures like howler monkeys, toucans, and sloths on your daily hikes.

The proximity to nature is complemented by modern amenities and conveniences. Nearby towns offer shopping, dining, and entertainment options, ensuring that you can enjoy the best of both worlds – the tranquility of nature and the comforts of contemporary living.

Whether you envision a luxurious mountain retreat or a charming countryside getaway, this building lot provides a versatile canvas for your architectural dreams. Build your dream home, complete with large windows to capture the panoramic views, expansive outdoor spaces, and lush gardens to immerse yourself in the Costa Rican wilderness.

In Cost Rica all beaches are public, but the only way to get to this private beach is through the Estuary by foot during low tide or through the property. On both sides there are Estuaries with 3 km / 1.8 miles of virgin beach and no development yet on this gorgeous property.

The seller’s are flexible and open to options and opportunities with the right investors. Owner financing, or selling parts of the property or a joint venture are all possibilities.

Price is very reasonable. Seller wants to see some action.

properties.title: Oceanfront Development Parcel Jaco Beach
properties.author: Shawnfletcher

content.body:
Oceanfront Development Parcel for Sale in Jacó Beach, Costa Rica

A Rare Oceanfront Development Opportunity on the South End of Jacó Beach

According to the current listing information, this oceanfront development parcel is located on Calle Madrigal at the southern end of Jacó Beach, Costa Rica. The property measures approximately 8,352 square meters, or just over two acres, and the listing reports approximately 110 meters, or 360 feet, of direct ocean frontage.

Offered at US$6,473,000, the parcel presents an opportunity for buyers seeking a substantial beachfront landholding near one of Costa Rica’s best-known Pacific Coast communities. The listing describes the property as fully titled, indicates that seller financing is available, and states that the land may support residential, commercial, or combined use. All ownership, frontage, land-use, zoning, infrastructure, and development information should be independently verified by the buyer through qualified Costa Rican legal, technical, and municipal professionals.

The property’s primary appeal begins with its setting. It sits directly beside the Pacific Ocean on the south end of Jacó Beach, where the coastline, tropical surroundings, and evening sunsets create a strong sense of place. The listing also describes the parcel as close to town, giving a future owner convenient access to the wider services, businesses, restaurants, recreation, and amenities available throughout Jacó.

This combination of oceanfront positioning, reported size, and proximity to town may make the property relevant to developers, hospitality groups, investment partnerships, family offices, or private buyers searching for a significant coastal asset in Costa Rica.

More Than Two Acres of Beachfront Land

With a reported land area of approximately 8,352 square meters, the parcel offers meaningful space for a buyer to evaluate a variety of potential concepts. Its reported 110 meters of ocean frontage is an especially notable feature because it creates a broad physical connection between the property and the Pacific coastline.

A parcel of this size may provide flexibility during conceptual planning. Subject to independent confirmation of zoning, density, setbacks, height restrictions, environmental requirements, access, utility capacity, water availability, wastewater solutions, and other regulations, a buyer may be able to explore residential, commercial, hospitality, or mixed-use possibilities.

No specific project, building area, unit count, density, or construction program is represented as approved. However, the site provides a compelling starting point for a buyer prepared to complete professional feasibility studies and determine the most appropriate use.

A future project could potentially be designed to emphasize ocean views, outdoor living, landscaped open spaces, and direct access to the beach. These are conceptual possibilities only and would depend entirely on applicable regulations, physical site conditions, permitting, infrastructure, and the buyer’s development plan.

For a buyer who values location and long-term flexibility, the parcel offers the opportunity to begin with a substantial piece of oceanfront land rather than adapting an existing structure to a new use.

Residential, Commercial, or Mixed-Use Possibilities

The listing states that the property allows residential, commercial, or combined use. This flexibility may appeal to buyers who want to evaluate several development directions before selecting a final concept.

A residential buyer or developer may wish to study the feasibility of private residences, condominiums, villas, or another form of coastal housing. A commercial or hospitality buyer may investigate whether the parcel could support a tourism, lodging, dining, wellness, or service-oriented concept. A mixed-use buyer may consider combining compatible uses within one coordinated plan.

These examples are not representations of approved uses or guaranteed development outcomes. Every concept would require independent review and confirmation by the relevant professionals and authorities.

The final use of the land should be based on a detailed process that includes legal due diligence, zoning confirmation, municipal consultation, architectural review, engineering studies, environmental analysis, infrastructure assessment, financial feasibility, and market research.

For experienced developers, the property’s reported land-use flexibility may offer room to compare several strategies. One buyer may prioritize a residential project. Another may focus on hospitality. A third may prefer to hold the land while completing planning, studies, or approvals.

Because the parcel is undeveloped, the opportunity lies in shaping a concept around the site rather than inheriting the limitations of an existing building.

Direct Connection to the Pacific Ocean

The ocean is the defining feature of this property.

The parcel’s reported beachfront position creates a strong visual and physical relationship with the Pacific. A future development, if approved, could potentially be organized around ocean views, sunset exposure, and outdoor spaces that respond to the coastal environment.

The south end of Jacó Beach is described in the listing as an attractive setting for sunsets and a family-friendly section of the coastline. These qualities may help shape the identity of a future residential or hospitality concept.

A well-planned project could potentially use the natural setting as its central theme. Architectural orientation, landscaping, circulation, common spaces, and outdoor areas could all be studied in relation to the beach and ocean. Any such design would need to respond to applicable setbacks, coastal regulations, environmental requirements, drainage, flood considerations, and engineering conditions.

The beachfront setting also gives the property a clear marketing identity. Buyers, guests, residents, and investors can immediately understand the appeal of land positioned directly beside the ocean.

Rather than relying on a distant view or off-site beach access, the parcel is marketed as a true oceanfront property. Buyers should nevertheless confirm the precise legal boundaries, surveyed frontage, public-zone requirements, access conditions, and any maritime or environmental restrictions before proceeding.

Close to Jacó and Its Amenities

The listing describes the property as close to town. This proximity may be valuable for a future owner or project because Jacó provides a broad range of services and conveniences.

The town includes restaurants, shops, supermarkets, professional services, recreation, transportation options, and other everyday amenities. A future development on the parcel may therefore benefit from being near an established coastal community rather than in a remote location with limited infrastructure.

The description should not be interpreted as a guarantee that every town amenity is comfortably walkable from the property. Travel times, pedestrian access, road conditions, and distances should be independently evaluated. However, the listing’s description of the parcel as close to town supports its position as an oceanfront site with convenient access to the wider Jacó area.

For residential buyers, proximity to services may improve day-to-day convenience. For a hospitality concept, it may provide guests with easier access to local dining, shopping, activities, and transportation. For an investor, it creates a straightforward location story: substantial oceanfront land near an established Costa Rican beach community.

A Potential Residential Development Site

Subject to approvals and professional feasibility studies, the parcel may be evaluated for residential development.

Potential residential concepts could include condominiums, private homes, villas, or another form of coastal housing. The appropriate concept would depend on confirmed zoning, permitted density, construction limits, site conditions, infrastructure, project costs, target market, and the buyer’s investment strategy.

A residential project might seek to emphasize natural light, ocean views, outdoor living, and direct access to the surrounding coastal environment. These are design ideas rather than existing features or approved plans.

A developer could also study the demand for full-time residences, second homes, retirement properties, or vacation-oriented ownership. No claim is made regarding projected sales, absorption, rental income, returns, or buyer demand. Those factors would require independent market research and financial analysis.

The parcel’s size may provide an opportunity to evaluate how residences, access, parking, landscaping, shared spaces, and amenities could be arranged. However, the actual development capacity cannot be determined from the listing alone.

Buyers should not rely on conceptual descriptions when making an acquisition decision. An architect, engineer, planner, attorney, and other qualified professionals should be engaged before assuming that a specific residential plan can be approved or constructed.

Commercial and Hospitality Considerations

The property may also be relevant to buyers exploring commercial or hospitality uses.

Possible concepts could include lodging, food and beverage, wellness, tourism services, or another coastal commercial use, provided the proposed use is legally permitted and technically feasible. These examples are illustrative only.

A hospitality buyer may value the direct oceanfront setting and proximity to Jacó. A commercial investor may be interested in a property that combines visibility, beach access, and a recognized location. A mixed-use developer may wish to investigate whether complementary components could be integrated into one plan.

No operational business, hotel license, restaurant approval, tourism permit, or commercial authorization is included or implied. A buyer would need to confirm all requirements with the appropriate Costa Rican authorities and professional advisers.

A full feasibility review should consider projected construction costs, operating expenses, staffing, utility capacity, access, parking, fire and safety requirements, water and wastewater systems, environmental approvals, market demand, and long-term operating risk.

The property’s value as a commercial or hospitality opportunity depends not only on the land itself, but also on the buyer’s ability to develop a realistic, compliant, and financially sustainable plan.

Seller Financing Available

The listing states that seller financing is available.

This may provide additional flexibility for a qualified buyer evaluating the acquisition. Seller financing can sometimes support a transaction structure that differs from an all-cash purchase or conventional bank financing.

However, the listing does not establish the down payment, interest rate, amortization period, loan term, security requirements, guarantees, qualification standards, payment schedule, default provisions, prepayment rights, or other financial conditions.

All terms would need to be negotiated directly and documented by qualified legal professionals.

A buyer should review any seller-financing proposal in the context of the total acquisition cost, due-diligence period, planning timeline, entitlement process, development budget, carrying costs, and future financing needs.

Seller financing should not be interpreted as a substitute for legal, financial, environmental, or technical due diligence. It is simply one potential transaction feature that may be available to an approved purchaser.

Fully Titled According to the Listing

The listing describes the property as fully titled.

This is an important statement for buyers evaluating coastal property in Costa Rica, but it should be independently confirmed before closing.

A qualified Costa Rican real estate attorney should verify the registered owner, title history, legal description, survey information, boundaries, recorded liens, easements, restrictions, access rights, mortgages, annotations, and any other matters affecting the property.

The buyer should also confirm whether any portion of the parcel is affected by maritime-zone regulations, public-use areas, environmental protections, setbacks, concessions, or other coastal requirements.

The reported 110 meters of ocean frontage and 8,352-square-meter land area should be compared with an updated survey and the records held by the relevant authorities.

The buyer’s legal team should also review the proposed transaction structure, whether the property is acquired directly, through a Costa Rican company, or through another legally appropriate arrangement.

No buyer should rely solely on marketing material when purchasing a multimillion-dollar coastal property. Independent verification is essential.

Development Due Diligence

A buyer considering this parcel should complete a comprehensive due-diligence process before releasing nonrefundable funds or committing to a development plan.

That process may include confirmation of:

Registered ownership and title status

Property boundaries and updated survey information

Exact land area and ocean frontage

Zoning and permitted uses

Density and building-height limitations

Required setbacks

Access rights and road conditions

Water availability

Wastewater requirements

Electrical and telecommunications capacity

Soil and geotechnical conditions

properties.author: Beaumaisel

content.body:
Eco-Oasis Retreat: Turnkey Opportunity in Playa Bejuco

Discover a rare blend of sustainability, nature, and hospitality in this thoughtfully developed eco-retreat. Over the past decade, the property has evolved from raw land into a fully operational rental business featuring six environmentally conscious units.

Just a five-minute walk from the sandy shores of Playa Bejuco, the location offers the privacy travelers seek while remaining close to restaurants, shops, medical services, and public transportation.

The property spans 5,000 m² (1.25 acres) and includes two well-designed buildings with a total of six units. Five are short-term rentals, and one serves as a private owner’s suite, creating flexibility for both lifestyle and income.

The container building is a striking three-level structure built from recycled shipping containers. It includes two one-bedroom apartments and a top-level terrace ideal for relaxing in hammocks and enjoying the surrounding nature.

The garden building is constructed from solid concrete and divided into four studio apartments. Each unit includes a kitchenette and private bathroom. Above, a large screened-in space offers a peaceful setting for yoga, lounging, or observing wildlife.

Sustainability is at the core of the property’s design. Recycled materials were used throughout construction, including plastic elements in gates, doors, and patios. A 16-panel solar system with battery backup supports energy independence.

Water management is handled by an advanced treatment system that recycles both black and grey water for irrigation. Two large backup water tanks ensure consistent supply throughout the property.

The grounds are designed using permaculture principles and support local wildlife. Fruit trees and multiple banana varieties attract monkeys, toucans, scarlet macaws, and sloths, creating a true nature sanctuary.

Mature trees such as Ceiba, Guanacaste, and Roble provide shade and character. A small river runs through the property, enhancing the natural setting and drawing diverse wildlife.

This is a proven investment with strong performance as a vacation rental. The property holds over 500 reviews and maintains a consistent five-star rating, attracting digital nomads, couples, and eco-conscious travelers.

Ownership offers flexibility. You can live on-site and manage the property directly, or transition to a local management company for a more hands-off investment approach.

Amenities are designed for both relaxation and activity. The pool serves as a central gathering point, complemented by a covered rancho. Additional features include a basketball court, yoga area, and ping-pong table.

Operational needs are well supported with two large storage areas and a fully equipped laundry room. There is ample parking for guests, including space for recreational vehicles.

This is a turnkey opportunity combining lifestyle, sustainability, and income potential in one of Costa Rica’s growing coastal destinations.

Price: $695,000 USD with owner financing available. Located in Playa Bejuco, Puntarenas, the property includes six bedrooms, six bathrooms, one full kitchen, and five kitchenettes. Key features include solar power, a swimming pool, high-speed internet, and no HOA fees.

With 230 m² of interior and exterior space, the single-level design provides an ideal setting for full-time living or weekend beach escapes. The solid construction and well-maintained condition make the home move-in ready, giving you a reliable property close to the coast.

Inside, the home features three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, along with an equipped kitchen that simplifies daily routines. Because the property is sold unfurnished, you have the freedom to tailor each space to your personal style. Split A/C units keep the interior cool throughout the year, while the layout supports easy flow between the living areas and the outdoors.

Covered parking for two vehicles adds convenience, and the small backyard provides space for gardening, grilling, or simply enjoying a quiet moment outside. A side access walkway further enhances practicality for day-to-day use.

Peaceful Community Living Close to the Beach

Located in the Camboya Jaco area, the home sits within a gated community. This offers 24-hour security, landscaped areas, a community pool, and a playground. These shared amenities create a relaxed environment suitable for families, retirees, or anyone seeking comfort and safety near the beach.

The property is positioned approximately ten blocks from the shoreline and downtown Jaco. Walk to the beach or take a short drive to restaurants, shops, supermarkets, and entertainment. Jaco Beach remains one of the most dynamic coastal towns in the Central Pacific, making this location especially convenient.

If you are searching for a well-built home in a secure community with excellent proximity to the beach and town amenities, this Jaco Beach gated 3-bedroom house is an excellent choice.

Three-Level Ocean View Residence With Exceptional Privacy

This Nativa Resort ocean view house with pool offers an extraordinary blend. Enjoy privacy, panoramic vistas, and refined comfort. All that in one of the most scenic gated communities along the Central Pacific. Set within a lush, elevated landscape, the home sits on 2,000 m², providing ample space and a privileged setting surrounded by nature.

The residence unfolds across three thoughtfully designed levels. On the first floor, you will find two bedrooms that share a peaceful terrace overlooking the tropical surroundings. This level also includes covered parking for two vehicles and generous storage space. It’s ideal for long-term living or extended stays.

Ocean Views and Impressive Indoor–Outdoor Living

The second floor is dedicated to the master suite. It features a spacious closet, a full bathroom with a relaxing tub, and its own balcony where you can enjoy serene moments and gentle breezes. Transitioning to the upper level, the home reveals its most captivating space: the social area. A large living room, dining space, and a beautifully equipped kitchen open onto a wide terrace and private pool. From here, you can enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf of Nicoya, the peninsula, and the captivating sunsets that paint the sky each evening.

Balconies on both the second and third floors further enhance the indoor & outdoor flow, offering multiple vantage points for admiring the natural landscape. The home is of solid construction, has been meticulously maintained, and has had only one owner.

Located within Nativa Resort, the property benefits from 24-hour security, well kept gardens, and access to community amenities. The gated environment ensures tranquility while remaining within easy reach of beaches, tourist attractions, and the conveniences of town.

If you would like more details or wish to schedule a visit, please feel free to contact me today.

6 Acres of Flat, Buildable Land—perfect for developing ridge-side bungalows, treehouses, or a small eco-resort.

Why Invest?

This property is a rare gem with enormous potential for eco-tourism, conservation, or creating a private paradise. Its strategic location at the end of the road provides privacy while being easily accessible to popular tourist destinations.

properties.title: Secluded Mountain View Home
properties.author: Travis Comstock

content.body:
SECLUDED MOUNTAIN-VIEW RETREAT – 17 ACRES NEAR LOS SUEÑOS

Total acreage opportunity with purchase of adjacent lot: 24 acres

This exceptional 6.8-hectare (17-acre) property—featuring a 3-bedroom main home and a separate caretaker’s house—sits high in the peaceful hills above Herradura, just 10 minutes from Los Sueños Resort & Marina. It’s also only 5 minutes from the Herradura/AutoMercado Mall and 10 minutes to Playa Jaco and Playa Herradura.

A VIEW THAT NEVER STOPS CHANGING

What truly sets this property apart is the view. Unlike an ocean view—beautiful but constant—this valley-and-mountain panorama shifts throughout the day and with every season. Morning mist rolls through the river valley, revealing layers of steep green hills and distant peaks. Afternoon light paints the mountainsides gold. Clouds gather and drift, creating dramatic shadows. Sunsets splash the entire valley in soft pinks and fiery reds.

Every moment from this home feels like watching a live nature documentary—always moving, constantly transforming, always breathtaking.

Guests consistently comment that it’s one of the most incredible views they’ve ever seen anywhere in Costa Rica.

LOCATION: CLOSE TO EVERYTHING, YET COMPLETELY PRIVATE

Despite its seclusion, the property is ideally situated near world-class amenities:

Los Sueños Resort & Marina (10 minutes):

18-hole Eco Golf Course, Marriott Hotel with spa and casino, fine dining, shops, and a vibrant international marina.

Herradura Beach (10 minutes):

Banks, a gourmet supermarket (fresh produce, seafood, meats, bakery), plus paddleboarding, kayaking, and jet skiing in the sheltered bay.

Jaco (10 minutes):

Restaurants, nightlife, shopping, activities, and tourism services.

THE LAND: A PRIVATE NATURE SANCTUARY

Quiet, private, and surrounded by rainforest and pasture, this property has no neighbors in sight or sound. Perfect for a personal retreat, a hobby farm, or a small horse property.

Fruit onsite includes avocado, coconut, water apple, yucca, banana, mango, and plantain.

Wildlife sightings are constant, including Scarlet Macaws, toucans, iguanas, opossums, white-faced monkeys, and deer—all visible right from the decks, with the sweeping valley framing every sighting.

THE HOME

3 bedrooms • 2 bathrooms • Sleeps 8

Breathable sandstone exterior

Cenisero tongue-and-groove wood ceilings

Artistically carved solid-wood doors

Curving pool deck with *two* additional lower decks, including a gazebo—each designed to soak in the ever-changing view

Imported Spanish tile

Guanacaste hardwood kitchen cabinets

A/C in every bedroom

Security camera system

Abundant well water + UV purification

On-demand electric hot water

Fully furnished

ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS

Bodega/laundry room

Two-car carport + ample additional parking

2-bedroom caretaker’s home tucked privately down the hill

Full-time caretaker living onsite

Seller financing available

EXPANSION OPTION

An adjoining 3-hectare (7-acre) property is also available, featuring rivers, trees, pasture, and its own private access.

Call today for a private showing—and experience the constantly changing, unforgettable mountain view for yourself.
