Visionary Development Opportunity: 111 Acres (45 Hectares) – Pacific Central, Costa Rica

Perfectly situated just 10 minutes from Los Sueños Marina, 15 minutes from Jacó, and 1 hour and 15 minutes from the San José International Airport, this expansive 111-acre (45-hectare) property offers an extraordinary canvas for a world-class master-planned development. Its strategic location blends privacy, nature, luxury tourism, and accessibility—ideal for residential, eco-friendly, and lifestyle-oriented projects.

This site can accommodate multiple complementary neighborhoods and experiences, creating a diversified and sustainable destination.

1. Inland Marina Community

An inland marina provides a signature feature that elevates the entire project. This unique amenity can include:

Navigable water channels

Dry slips and boat storage

Waterfront townhomes or condos

Marina village with retail, dining, and entertainment

Fishing-focused amenities for anglers visiting Los Sueños

Given its proximity to the world-renowned Los Sueños Resort & Marina, an inland marina expands capacity for boating enthusiasts and creates a high-value residential environment.

2. Eco-Developments with Condominiums

A series of low-impact condominium clusters can be designed with:

Sustainable architecture

Solar and rainwater systems

Jungle and mountain views

Walking trails and nature corridors

Community pools, yoga pavilions, and wellness spaces

These eco-developments appeal to buyers seeking modern comfort integrated with Costa Rica’s natural beauty—particularly long-term residents and digital nomads.

3. Residential Houses

Single-family homes can be distributed throughout the property to offer:

Spacious private lots

Mountain, jungle, or waterway views

Lot area is 1570 m2 (17, 900 sq. ft.), plus 500 m2 (5400 sq. ft.) of protected riverbank, small and scenic river runs through the back border of the property. Zero flooding issues as the river area is protected by a 60-meter long, 4-meter-high, retaining wall built out of stone ($16,000 investment).

MAIN HOUSE: a “ranch style” (one level) spacious home of 275 m2 (2960 sq. ft.), open floor plan, living room, and the kitchen has a “communal” feel. 2 guest bedrooms, each with their own full bathrooms. 6 1-bedroom Apartments

There are terrace and garden areas for BBQs, deck areas, hammock areas, kitchen/bar areas, fruit trees, tropical flora and fauna, storage, a huge shop for tools and equipment, and a gym area.

There is an indoor/outdoor security system with 8 cameras, gated areas for pets, a covered parking area for 4 cars, and a second 2-door garage there is also a large tool shed and workroom, and high walls protect all of it, but no one can see into this compound.

40 Solar Panels system and a new roof were installed. The owner is retiring to a smaller property and is motivated. This is an income-producing property and numbers will be discussed for qualified buyers.

También hay un amplio cobertizo para herramientas y un taller, todo protegido por muros altos, pero nadie puede ver el interior del complejo.

Level Terrain, Utilities Available, and Zoned for Four Floors

The land is level and surrounded by natural vegetation, providing privacy, beauty, and an inviting tropical setting. A source of fresh water is located on-site, and both electricity and municipal water are available for immediate construction. Land-use regulations permit construction of up to four floors, offering significant flexibility for designing a spacious residence or multi-level project.

Cerro Fresco is an area experiencing rapid development, with road improvements and asphalt access anticipated in the near term. Its location is one of the strongest advantages: Playa Hermosa is recognized for its spectacular sunsets, acclaimed surfing conditions, and proximity to the region’s most popular attractions. Jaco Beach, with its restaurants, shops, and services, is only minutes away. The capital city and the international airport are easily accessible, making this an ideal site for a primary home or a coastal retreat.

Large Lot Steps From the Shore in Jaco’s Fastest-Growing Area

Measuring 1,831 m², the property sits just 100 meters from the shoreline at the Las Monas River, in an area that is rapidly transforming thanks to new infrastructure and improved access. For years, this part of town was difficult to reach, preserving its untouched character. Today, with major upgrades underway, it stands out as one of the most attractive zones for long-term growth and development.

The location delivers a peaceful natural setting while still being close to Jaco’s main services, restaurants, and commercial activity. The combination of privacy, proximity to the beach, and improved accessibility makes this one of the last premium land opportunities available in the north sector of town.

Flexible Zoning and Strong Development Potential

The lot allows various building possibilities, giving future owners flexibility to design a single-family home, a boutique condominium project, or even a small hotel. Its flat topography and generous size make the planning and building process more efficient, while the riverside position and surrounding natural landscape offer an appealing backdrop for future construction.

Jaco continues to grow quickly as a vibrant coastal community, drawing both locals and international visitors. Properties of this scale and location are increasingly difficult to find, making this lot an exceptional option for buyers seeking land with both lifestyle appeal and long-term development potential.

content.body:
Restaurant and Minimarket in Prime Location Near the Beach

This Herradura income property presents an excellent opportunity to acquire two established businesses in a highly strategic location. With 280 m² of solid construction, the property includes a fully operating small restaurant and a minimarket, both positioned just minutes from Herradura Beach and the renowned Los Sueños Marina. The area maintains steady demand from locals, visitors, and those commuting to the marina, giving the businesses consistent visibility and customer flow.

The restaurant currently operates as a traditional “sodita,” offering a warm and familiar atmosphere. Its layout, however, allows for easy adaptation into any food concept. Whether casual dining, café-style service, or takeout. This flexibility provides new owners the freedom to tailor the space to their preferred style or expand service options.

Growing Commercial Area With Expansion Potential

The attached minimarket offers strong potential. Especially since there are no similar stores in the immediate surroundings. Its convenient position near the beach makes it attractive for neighborhood residents, tourists, and weekend visitors. With the growing popularity of Herradura and the constant activity surrounding Los Sueños Resort, this commercial corridor continues to evolve, providing promising long-term demand.

The property’s sturdy construction and ample space allow for future improvements or expansion, depending on the buyer’s vision. Herradura remains one of the most desirable beaches in the Central Pacific, appreciated for its calm waters, mountain views, and proximity to all essential services.
